法租界黄包车夫注册事宜

鉴于法方当局自1935年8月1日起扣押由未注册车夫拉动的黄包车，截至目前仅有74名车夫自愿注册。为强制执行此注册规定，法国警察于1935年8月1日扣押了283辆由未注册车夫（原文为colies，疑为coolies之误）拉动的黄包车，并于1935年8月2日扣押了133辆。在所有案件中，黄包车夫均被释放。

8月2日上午，上海市公共黄包车车主协会南市办事处委员仇素山（Jem Tsung-san，音译，前文作仇春山）在几名黄包车夫代表的陪同下，前往上海市政府办公地，恳请协助劝说方当局不要在注册黄包车夫时采取强制措施。向社会局也提出了类似的请求。在两处，来访者均被告知不要制造麻烦，静待中国当局谈判的结果。

1935年8月2日下午4时30分，上海市公共黄包车车主协会南市办事处的11名委员在南市蒲东路（Pu Yueh Tung Road）三明坊34号的办事处举行会议，并通过以下决议：-

pages.en:

1. That all ricsha owners be instructed to report to the Owners' Association the number of their ricshas detained by the French Authorities in order that statistics of losses, may be compiled and the losses be borne by all the owners/

2. That should the French Police decide to hold owners responsible for the licensing of pullers, all owners be instructed not to take out licences for the month of August, 1935.

3. That information on the present situation be conveyed to the ricsha owners in the Western District, who have agreed to join this movement.

An appeal for assistance was made by the Committee to the Chinese Chamber of Commerce on August 2.

Upon learning of the intention of the French Police to work for the dissolution of the Nantao Office of the Shanghai Municipality Public Ricsha Owners' Association, the committee decided to make an announcement that the opposition to the licensing of pullers by the French Authorities is being conducted by the owners and pullers themselves and the Nantao Office of the Association is taking no part in the opposition.

Some 90 ricsha pullers held a meeting on a piece of vacant ground off San Ming Feng, Fu Yueh Tung Road, Nantao, at 1 p.m. August 2, 1935, and passed the following resolutions :-

1. That the assistance of the Chinese Authorities be solicited.

2. That Chen Kuo-liang be requested to participate in the movement to oppose the registration.

3. That should efforts to bring about the cancellation of this registration prove of no avail the following demands be submitted to the Authorities concerned :-
pages.zh:
1935年8月3日。

杂项 (4)

1. 指示所有黄包车车主向车主协会报告被法方当局扣押的黄包车数量，以便统计损失，并由所有车主共同承担损失/

2. 若法国警察决定让车主对车夫的执照负责，则指示所有车主不要申领1935年8月份的执照。

3. 将当前局势的信息传达给已同意加入此次运动的西区黄包车车主。

委员会于8月2日向上海总商会请求援助。

得知法国警察意图解散上海市公共黄包车车主协会南市办事处后，委员会决定发布公告，称反对法方当局对车夫实行执照制的行动是由车主和车夫自行开展的，协会南市办事处并未参与此次反对行动。

约90名黄包车夫于1935年8月2日下午1时，在南市蒲东路（Fu Yueh Tung Road，原文与前页Pu Yueh Tung Road拼写略有不同，照实译）三明坊附近的一块空地上举行会议，并通过以下决议：-

1. 请求中国当局提供援助。

2. 请求陈国良（Chen Kuo-liang，音译）参与反对注册的行动。

3. 若努力取消此注册证明无效，则向有关当局提出以下要求：-

pages.en:
August 3, 1935.

Miscellaneous (5)

(A) That the registration fee of 50 cents be abolished.
(B) That the Police be forbidden to remove licence plates indiscriminately, and that duplicate be issued without question to any one who has lost the original plate.
(C) That no photographs or finger prints be taken of coolies applying for registration.
(D) That the above demands be kept secret for the time being.

J.K. Givan
D.C. (Special Branch).

1935年8月3日。

J.K. Givan

August 3, 1935.
Morning Translation.

Shanghai Morning Post and other local newspapers:
RICSHA TROUBLE IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION

As public ricsha coolies in the French
Concession are opposing registration, the French Municipal
Council has ordered the compulsory registration of coolies
as from August 1. Ricshas of pullers who have not
registered will be detained.
On August 1, some 700 ricshas were seized
and detained by the French Police. The French Police
continued to seize ricshas yesterday and over 1,000
vehicles are now being detained at the Police Stations.
When the French Police seized a ricsha, the
puller usually ran away leaving the vehicle behind.
In some instances the Police took the pullers to the
Registration Office on Route Stanislas Chevalier to register.
In all, only 14 ricsha coolies were made to register in
this manner on August 1 and 2.
The number of ricshas in the French Concession
has been greatly reduced through the action of the
French Police and residents are experiencing much
inconvenience. Trams and buses are making good business.
The ricsha coolies who had been deprived of
their vehicles, later brought their aged parents and
children to the Ricsha Owners' Association, asking for
relief.

On August 2, three representatives of the
Ricsha Owners' Association called at the Chinese Chamber
of Commerce, and after making a report on the ricsha
trouble in the French Concession, they requested the
Chamber to induce the authorities of the French Concession
to modify their violent measure.
Nyi Ngau Sung (聶傲聲), Secretary of the
Chamber, who received the representatives, promised to
detail deputies to conduct an investigation.

At 2 p.m. yesterday Zee Hung Sung (徐洪生)
and five other representatives of ricsha coolies in the
French Concession proceeded to the Civic Centre and
submitted an appeal to the Bureau of Social Affairs.
As the appeal had not been sealed by the
representatives, the Bureau of Social Affairs instructed
the representatives to rectify the omission. When the
representatives called at the Shanghai City Government,
it was past regular office hours.
The representatives of the ricsha coolies
will visit the Chinese Authorities again on August 3
to submit an appeal. They will also ask the Chinese
Ratepayers' Association of the French Concession and the
Citizens' Federation for assistance.

Ricsha pullers have sent the following petition
to the Kuomintang and other political organs:-
"After the French Concession Authorities had
issued a notice calling for the registration of ricsha
pullers, we were repeatedly persuaded by the Ricsha Owners
Association to comply with the order; but most of the pullers

1935年8月3日。

《上海晨报》及其他本地报纸：
法租界人力车纠纷

由于法租界的公共人力车夫反对登记，法国公董局已下令自8月1日起强制车夫登记。未登记车夫的人力车将被扣留。
8月1日，约有700辆人力车被法国警察查扣并拘留。法国警察昨日继续查扣人力车，目前各警察局内被扣留的车辆已超过1,000辆。
当法国警察查扣人力车时，车夫通常弃车而逃。在某些情况下，警察将车夫带至霞飞路（Route Stanislas Chevalier）的登记处进行登记。8月1日和2日两天，以这种方式被迫登记的人力车夫总共只有14人。
由于法国警察的行动，法租界内的人力车数量大幅减少，居民感到诸多不便。电车和公共汽车生意兴隆。
那些车辆被剥夺的人力车夫，后来带着年迈的父母和孩子来到人力车主协会，请求救济。

8月2日，人力车主协会的三名代表拜访了上海总商会，在汇报了法租界人力车纠纷情况后，请求商会促使法租界当局修改其暴力措施。
接待代表的商会秘书聂傲声（Nyi Ngau Sung）承诺派遣专员进行调查。

昨日下午2时，徐洪生（Zee Hung Sung）及另外五名法租界人力车夫代表前往市中心，向社会局提交请愿书。
由于请愿书未经代表盖章，社会局指示代表补正这一疏漏。当代表们前往上海市政府时，已过正常办公时间。
人力车夫代表将于8月3日再次拜访中国当局，提交请愿书。他们还将请求法租界华人纳税会及市民联合会提供协助。

人力车夫已向国民党及其他政治机构发送如下请愿书：
“法租界当局发布通知要求人力车夫登记后，我们虽经人力车主协会反复劝告服从命令；但大多数车夫

"Ricsha pullers are treated like animals. They
have to work incessently in hot and cold weather. Their
daily earnings, after deducting hiring fees, is so small
that they are unable to procure sufficient food and in
case they have a big family, they have often to forego
meals. When business is poor, this suspension of meals
lasts several days. The registration will require each
ricsha puller to pay a fee of 50 cents. This is a heavy
burden to them. French Police officers are instructed to
bring in a certain number of ricsha cases each month, and
many coolies have been unreasonably deprived of their
licence by the Police. When a licence is lost or stolen,
a new licence cannot be quickly secured and both the
puller and the ricsha owner have to suffer. Ricsha
pullers are human beings, and if they comply with this
registration order, they should not be photographed and
finger-printed in a rough manner. Furthermore, ricsha
pullers will be deprived of their freedom once they have
registered, because after registration, they are tied
down to their profession. These few points show the
illegal treatment of ricsha pullers. Nevertheless, the
French Authorities are resorting to high-handed measures
to oppress the pullers. The other day, several hundred
ricshas were seized and detained by the Police. During
the present trade depression, this action of the Concession
Authorities cannot be tolerated. The pullers are
indignant over such action. If trouble arises, it
will lead to a serious situation. We hereby request you
to be in sympathy with the pullers and to lodge a protest
with the French Authorities over the registration of
pullers."

Ricsha Owners in Sympathy with Coolies

The Shanghai District Ricsha Owners Association
publishes the following statement in the advertisement
columns of the Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-
"The registration of ricsha pullers is being
generally opposed by pullers. For the sake of our
business, ricsha owners are in sympathy with the pullers.
This Association is the only organization of ricsha owners,
and its duty is to protest the interests of the members.
It represents the owners in the negotiations over this
case and to secure assistance from various parties. The
Bureau of Social Affairs and the Chamber of Commerce have
mediated, but the French Authorities are insisting on
registration and have rejected mediation. On August 1,
the French Police arrested pullers on the streets in
order to enforce the registration. The ricsha owners
has sustained heavy loss and about 1,000 pullers have
been rendered idle. The situation is rather serious
now. In case of untoward incidents arising, the French
Authorities should be held responsible. We
apart from protecting the interests of owners, will not
participate in any movement to be started by the pullers."

不愿登记，因为他们无法承受由此带来的苦难。
人力车夫被视为牲畜。他们必须在寒暑天气中不停地工作。扣除租车费后的每日收入微乎其微，以致无法购买足够的食物，如果家庭人口众多，他们经常不得不忍饥挨饿。当生意清淡时，这种断炊情况会持续数天。登记要求每位人力车夫缴纳50美分费用。这对他们来说是一笔沉重的负担。法国警官奉命每月必须查获一定数量的人力车案件，许多车夫被警察无理吊销执照。当执照遗失或被盗时，无法迅速补办新执照，车夫和车主都要遭受损失。人力车夫是人，如果他们服从这项登记命令，就不应以粗暴的方式对他们进行拍照和按指纹。此外，人力车夫一旦登记就将失去自由，因为登记后，他们就被束缚在这个职业上。这几点表明了人力车夫受到的非法待遇。尽管如此，法国当局仍采取高压手段压迫车夫。日前，数百辆人力车被警察查扣并拘留。在当前商业萧条之际，租界当局的这种行为是不能容忍的。车夫们对这种行为感到愤怒。如果发生骚乱，将导致严重局势。我们特此请求你们同情车夫，并就车夫登记一事向法国当局提出抗议。”

车主同情车夫

上海地区人力车主协会在《申报》及其他本地报纸的广告栏刊登如下声明：
“人力车夫的登记普遍遭到车夫反对。为了我们的业务，人力车主对车夫表示同情。本协会是人力车主的唯一组织，其职责是维护会员利益。本协会代表车主就此案进行谈判，并寻求各方协助。社会局和总商会曾进行调解，但法国当局坚持登记，拒绝调解。8月1日，法国警察在街头逮捕车夫以强制执行登记。人力车主遭受重大损失，约1,000名车夫失业。目前局势相当严峻。若发生不测事件，法国当局应承担责任。我们除了保护车主利益外，不会参与由车夫发起的任何运动。”

August 3, 1935. Morning Translation.

Min Pao (official organ of the Kuomintang) publishes the following brief comment to-day :-

NEWSPAPER COMMENT AND SUGGESTIONS

I fully agree with the desire of the French Municipal Council to enforce a registration of ricsha coolies in the French Concession. Such action is justified and reasonable. However, I do not consider it wise to arrest the coolies or to detain their ricshas at the Police Stations in order to enforce a compulsory registration.

The coolies are all illiterate persons and do not understand the meaning of the word "registration". They rather prefer to lose their ricshas than to be arrested and to be compelled to register. This misunderstanding is due simply to their ignorance. They certainly do not want to disobey the instructions of the French Municipal Council.

Therefore, in my opinion, it would be more effective if the French Municipal Council would cease arresting coolies and detaining their ricshas to enforce registration for it might give rise to disturbances and detail a number of educated persons to visit those places frequented by coolies, give them verbal explanations as to the reasons, the advantages and disadvantages of registration.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

PAWNSHOPS SUBMIT APPEAL TO CITY GOVERNMENT

In compliance with the instructions of the Bureau of Social Affairs of the Shanghai City Government, the First and Second Class Pawnshop Keepers Association yesterday submitted the following petition to the Bureau:-

"Owing to the sharp fall in the price of goods and frequent changes in the fashions of dress, the pawnshops have sustained serious losses during the past few years. Moreover, few of the articles pawned are redeemed. In former days, they can be sold at some profit but at this time of business depression, they can only be disposed of at considerable loss. Under these circumstances many shops have ceased operations and unless measures are devised to ameliorate the situation, all pawnshops in Shanghai will have to go out of business. Such a crisis can only be averted by a reduction in house rent, shortening of the period of redemption of pledges, lowering the offers for pledges and charging low interest.

"We, therefore, request that the Bureau devise ways and means to rectify the situation so as to save the pawnshops from going out of business."

1935年8月3日。晨间译件。

《民报》（国民党机关报）今日发表如下简短评论：

报纸评论与建议

我完全同意法国公董局希望在法租界强制实施人力车夫登记的愿望。此举正当且合理。然而，我认为为了强制执行登记而逮捕车夫或将他们的人力车扣留在警察局并非明智之举。

车夫均为文盲，不理解“登记”一词的含义。他们宁愿失去人力车，也不愿被捕并被迫登记。这种误解仅仅是由于他们的无知。他们当然不想违抗法国公董局的指令。

因此，在我看来，如果法国公董局停止通过逮捕车夫和扣留其人力车来强制执行登记，效果会更好，因为这可能会引起骚乱；相反，应派遣一些受过教育的人员前往车夫常去的地方，口头向他们解释登记的原因、利弊。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

典当业向市政府提交请愿书

遵照上海市政府社会局的指示，一二级当铺同业公会昨日向该局提交了如下请愿书：

“由于物价急剧下跌以及服装款式频繁变化，过去几年典当业遭受了严重损失。此外，很少有情物被赎回。过去，这些物品可以以一定的利润出售，但在当前商业萧条时期，只能以相当大的亏损处理。在这种情况下，许多店铺已停止营业，除非制定措施改善局势，否则上海所有当铺都将不得不倒闭。只有通过降低房租、缩短赎当期限、降低当价和收取低息，才能避免此类危机。

“因此，我们请求该局制定办法纠正局势，以挽救当铺免于倒闭。”

August 2, 1935.

Miscellaneous (4)

Nantao-Frenchtown Ricshas - French Police starts
action against unlicensed pullers

On August 1, the French Police commenced to arrest
unlicensed pullers operating ricshas (No.16,001 to No.17,100)
in the French Concession. A total of 24 coolies were
taken to the French Police Station. The ricshas were
detained and the coolies released. This action was
taken owing to the failure of the pullers of the vehicles
to take out licences with the French Police before
July 31.

It is learned that the local French Consul-General
has written to the Shanghai City Government, requesting
assistance in dissolving the Nantao Office of the
Shanghai Municipality Public Ricsha Owners' Association,
Nantao, for obstructing the lawful discharge of public
function by the C.M.F. in respect of the licensing of
coolies.

On August 1, the Nantao Office of the Shanghai
Municipality Public Ricsha Owners' Association received
instructions from the Bureau of Social Affairs holding it
responsible to assist the C.M.F. in the licensing of
pullers in the French Concession. The Bureau promised
to negotiate with the C.M.F. for the following concessions:-
1. That the date of commencing the registration be
postponed to October 1, 1935, and it be concluded by
the end of June, 1936.
2. That the order relating to the taking of finger
prints of coolies on registration be cancelled.
3. That the registration fee be reduced from 50 cents
to 25 cents.

1935年8月2日。

杂项 (4)

南市-法华界人力车 - 法国警察开始打击无照车夫

8月1日，法国警察开始在法租界逮捕运营无照人力车（第16,001号至第17,100号）的车夫。共有24名苦力被带到法国警察局。人力车被扣留，苦力被释放。采取此行动是因为这些车辆的车夫未在7月31日之前向法国警察申领执照。

据悉，当地法国总领事已致函上海市政府，请求协助解散位于南市的上海市公共人力车主协会南市办事处，因其阻碍了法国公董局（C.M.F.）依法履行关于苦力执照发放的公共职能。

8月1日，上海市公共人力车主协会南市办事处收到社会局指令，要求其负责协助法国公董局在法租界进行车夫执照发放工作。社会局承诺就以下让步与法国公董局进行谈判：
1. 将开始登记的日期推迟至1935年10月1日，并于1936年6月底前完成。
2. 取消关于在登记时对苦力采集指纹的命令。
3. 将登记费从50美分降至25美分。

Miscellaneous (5)

Between 10.30 a.m. and 2 p.m. August 1, 100 owners
and 20 self-styled coolies held a meeting in the "Free
Coffin Distribution Centre" of the Association, 25 San
Kwan Dong Ka, Loh Ka Pang Road, Nantao. At the
commencement of the meeting, several owners declared that
business should immediately be suspended. They were,
however, persuaded by members of the presidium not to
adopt this course. The following resolutions were then
discussed and passed :-

1. That a large number of coolies be sent to appeal to
the Chinese Chamber of Commerce and the Shanghai City
Government for assistance in the opposition to the
licensing of pullers.

2. That the National Government be requested to assist
the coolies.

3. That a manifesto be issued.

4. That the local French Consul-General be informed of the
evils which would arise from the registration of
coolies.

5. That the losses sustained by owners of ricshas
detained by the French Police owing to the coolies
failing to get licensed, be shared by all the owners.

6. That should the situation develop unfavourably, a
suspension of business be declared.

At 3 p.m. the same day representatives of the owners
and coolies who called at the Shanghai City Government and
the Bureau of Social Affairs were informed that the
Chinese Authorities were considering the matter.

Some 90 coolies led by Chao Dz-ching (赵子清), a
puller who it is believed is in the pay of the owners,
held a meeting on a piece of vacant ground at Nantao
Bund, Loh Ka Pang, between 4.30 p.m. and 5.30 p.m. August 1.

August 2, 1935.
Morning Translation.

Shanghai Morning Post and other local newspapers:

RICSHA TROUBLE IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION

The French Authorities opened the registration
of public ricsha coolies on July 1, but not a single
coolie has registered.
At 9 a.m. yesterday, detectives and policemen
of the French Police seized ricshas on the streets and
compelled the pullers to register. The coolies, however,
were unwilling to register and ran away leaving their
ricshas at the Police Stations. In all, about 700 to
800 ricshas were seized by the French Police yesterday.
The coolies whose ricshas had been detained by the French
Police called at the Ricsha Owners' Association and
requested assistance.

At 9 a.m. yesterday ricsha owners held a
meeting and passed the following resolutions:-
1) That joint action be taken with the coolies.
2) That the French Municipal Council be held responsible
for any damage to ricshas or loss to coolies or for
any dispute arising from the action of the Council in
preventing the coolies from carrying on their profession.
3) That the high handed measures of the French Municipal
Council be opposed.
4) That an appeal be submitted to the Shanghai City
Government.

At 2 p.m. yesterday Zeu Tsung San (仇春山),
Chang Van Yang (张万扬) and Yu Ta Ching (于达青), representatives
of ricsha owners in the French Concession, approached the
Bureau of Social Affairs and submitted an appeal. A
delegate of the Bureau promised to transmit their appeal
to the French Authorities for consideration.

In view of the grave situation created by the
seizure of ricshas by the French Municipal Council, ricsha
coolies in the French Concession held a meeting at 1 p.m.
yesterday at Nan Moo Dau (南码头), Nantao. Sz Zeng Sun
(时长生) presided. The following resolutions were passed:-
1) That the registration of ricsha coolies by the French
Municipal Council be unanimously opposed.
2) That representatives be elected to ask the Ricsha
Owners' Association, the local Tangpu and other political
organs for assistance.

It is learned that representatives of ricsha
coolies will call at the Shanghai City Government, the
Bureau of Social Affairs and other organizations on August 2
to present an appeal.

The French Police has issued the following
information:-
"As ricsha owners in the French Concession
are preventing ricsha coolies from registering, the French
Authorities are enforcing, as from to-day (August 1),
the measures for the registration of ricsha coolies which
were published in local newspapers on July 26. 215 ricshas,
the pullers of which should have registered with the
French Authorities during July but had failed to do so,
have been detained. No untoward incidents have occurred

1935年8月2日。
晨间译件。

《上海晨报》及其他本地报纸：

法租界人力车纠纷

法国当局于7月1日开始对公共人力车夫进行登记，但尚无一名车夫登记。
昨日上午9时，法国警察局的侦探和警员在街上扣押人力车，并强迫车夫登记。然而，车夫们不愿登记，弃车而逃，将人力车留在警察局。昨日法国警方共扣押了约700至800辆人力车。人力车被法国警方扣留的车夫前往人力车主协会求助。

昨日上午9时，人力车主举行会议，并通过以下决议：-
1) 与车夫采取联合行动。
2) 法国公董局应对因阻止车夫从业而引起的任何人力车损坏、车夫损失或任何纠纷负责。
3) 反对法国公董局的强硬措施。
4) 向上海市政府提出申诉。

昨日下午2时，法租界人力车主代表仇春山 (Zeu Tsung San)、张万扬 (Chang Van Yang) 和于达青 (Yu Ta Ching) 前往社会局并提交申诉书。社会局代表承诺将他们的申诉转交法国当局审议。

鉴于法国公董局扣押人力车造成的严峻局势，法租界的人力车夫于昨日下午1时在南市南码头 (Nan Moo Dau) 举行会议。时长生 (Sz Zeng Sun) 主持。通过以下决议：-
1) 一致反对法国公董局对人力车夫的登记。
2) 选举代表向人力车主协会、当地党部及其他政治机构请求援助。

据悉，人力车夫代表将于8月2日前往上海市政府、社会局及其他组织提交申诉。

法国警方发布如下信息：-
“由于法租界的人力车主阻止人力车夫登记，法国当局自今日（8月1日）起强制执行7月26日在当地报纸上公布的人力车夫登记措施。215辆人力车已被扣留，其车夫本应在7月期间向法国当局登记但未这样做。未发生不幸事件，

as the detectives and policemen of the French Police are adopting peaceful measures. When questioned at the Police Stations, several ricsha coolies declared that they had not registered because they had not received any instructions to that effect from the ricsha owners, others said that they had not known that registration of coolies by the French Authorities had commenced, while some said that the ricsha owners had prohibited them from registering.
"Local Chinese and foreign newspapers have published incorrect reports on the ricsha question. The following information is correct:-
1) The French Authorities will not place a limit on the registration of ricsha coolies and have explained to ricsha owners that all coolies, irrespective of their number, will be permitted to register.
2) According to information received, the French Authorities have verified that the opposition to the registration of ricsha coolies is the work of the owners and not of the coolies. Many coolies have registered to-day (August 1) in accordance with the measures of the French Authorities."

The Star Daily News (明星日報), a mosquito newspaper, published the following article on August 1 :-

THE FUTURE OF THE WORLD NEWS AGENCY

Some time ago, this paper published a report to the effect that the World News Agency would in all probability be incorporated with the Shun Tz News Agency. This report has now been proved to be groundless because of the following reasons:-
After his appointment as Managing Director of the "China Press", through the influence of Dr. H.H. Kung, Minister of Finance, Yang Kwang Sung (楊光注) saw that he could not find time to attend concurrently to the affairs of the World News Agency. Moreover, as this news agency does not possess much influence in newspaper circles, and its past services to the community had not been quite satisfactory, Yang Kwang Sung deemed it unnecessary to continue the service . However, he did not like to have the history of the news agency removed from the memory of the public; he, therefore, suggested its incorporation with the Shun Tz News Agency. The negotiations between the World News Agency and the Shun Tz News Agency, however, broke down, because Dr. Kung had withdrawn his subsidy to the World News Agency.
It is learnt that the World News Agency is now in very straightened circumstances. It will give up the despatching of telegraphic reports. Only a couple of reporters are at present being employed so as to secure payments from the newspapers and prolong its existence.

因为法国警察局的侦探和警员正采取和平措施。在警察局接受询问时，几名人力车夫声称，他们未登记是因为未收到车主的相关指示；其他人说他们不知道法国当局已开始对车夫进行登记；还有一些人说车主禁止他们登记。
“本地中外报纸关于人力车问题的报道不实。以下信息是正确的：-
1) 法国当局不会对人力车夫的登记设定限额，并已向人力车主解释，无论人数多少，所有车夫均获准登记。
2) 根据收到的信息，法国当局已核实，反对人力车夫登记的是车主而非车夫。许多车夫已按照法国当局的措施于今日（8月1日）登记。”

小报《明星日报》于8月1日刊登了以下文章：-

世界新闻社的前途

前一段时间，本报发表报道，称世界新闻社极有可能并入顺兹新闻社 (Shun Tz News Agency)。现证实该报道毫无根据，原因如下：-
杨光注 (Yang Kwang Sung) 在财政部长孔祥熙博士的影响下被任命为《China Press》总经理后，发现自己无暇兼顾世界新闻社的事务。此外，由于该新闻社在报界影响力不大，且过去对社区的服务并不令人满意，杨光注认为没有必要继续维持该服务。然而，他不希望该新闻社的历史从公众记忆中抹去；因此，他建议将其并入顺兹新闻社。然而，世界新闻社与顺兹新闻社之间的谈判破裂，因为孔博士撤回了对世界新闻社的补贴。
据悉，世界新闻社目前处境非常艰难。它将停止发送电报新闻。目前仅雇佣几名记者，以便从报社收取费用并延长其生存时间。

August 1, 1935. Morning Translation.

Shanghai Morning Post and other local newspapers

RICSHA OWNERS SUBMIT APPEAL TO THE RATEPAYERS' ASSOCIATION

Ricsha owners in the Special District some time ago submitted a petition to the Chinese Ratepayers' Association asking it to request the S.M.C. to devise proper relief measures for ricsha coolies.
At 3 p.m. yesterday, Loh Teh Shing (陸德馨) and Chang Zing Poo (張靜波), two ricsha owners representing some 400 owners, called at the Chinese Ratepayers' Association and submitted an appeal.
Tao Lo Jing (陶魯敬), Secretary of the Association, who received the callers, promised to convey their appeal to the S.M.C.
The appeal reads as follows:-
"We, ricsha owners, sent a petition to your Association on July 24 requesting the Association to urge the S.M.C. to maintain the original type of ricsha and to instruct the Ricsha Pullers Mutual Aid Association to carry out relief work for ricsha coolies immediately. On July 30 we received a reply stating that the matter had been taken up with the S.M.C. We do not know whether you have received a reply from the Council, and if no reply has been received, we have to request your Association to procure a reply from the Council."

Opposition to the Registration of Ricsha Coolies by the French Municipal Council

The French Municipal Council commenced the registration of public ricsha coolies a month ago. However up to the present, not a single ricsha coolie has registered owing to the strong opposition on the part of both ricsha owners and coolies. The French Municipal Council now proposes to suppress, as from August 1, all ricshas the pullers of which have not registered. Two days ago the Council requested the Shanghai City Government for assistance in the matter.
On July 31, some 40 representatives of ricsha coolies led by Sz Zang Sun (時長生) called at the Nantao Ricsha Owners' Association, No. 24 San Min Faung (三民坊), Poo Yeeh Tung Road (普育東路) and declared that ricsha coolies were unanimously opposed to registration by the French Municipal Council. The coolies will submit another appeal on August 1.
Ricsha owners in the French Concession will hold a meeting to-day to discuss the situation.
A certain representative of ricsha owners, interviewed by our reporter yesterday, made the following statements:- "The registration of ricsha coolies will be decided by the coolies themselves. Most of the coolies are ignorant peasants and do not understand the meaning of registration. Some time ago, many ricsha coolies returned to the country because of the introduction of registration and the business of ricsha owners was seriously affected. Later ricsha owners gave a guarantee that there would be no registration of coolies and the matter was thus settled. If registration is eventually carried out, the ricsha coolies will again return to the country

《上海晨报》及其他本地报纸

人力车主向纳税人协会提交申诉

特别区的人力车主前一段时间向华人纳税人协会提交请愿书，请求该协会要求工部局 (S.M.C.) 为人力车夫制定适当的救济措施。
昨日下午3时，代表约400名车主的两名人力车主陆德馨 (Loh Teh Shing) 和张静波 (Chang Zing Poo) 前往华人纳税人协会并提交申诉。
接待来访者的协会秘书陶鲁敬 (Tao Lo Jing) 承诺将他们的申诉转达给工部局。
申诉内容如下：-
“我们人力车主于7月24日向贵协会发送请愿书，请求协会敦促工部局保持原有类型的人力车，并指示人力车夫互助会立即为人力车夫开展救济工作。7月30日，我们收到回复，称此事已与工部局接洽。我们不知贵方是否已收到理事会的回复，如果尚未收到回复，我们要请求贵协会向理事会索取回复。”

反对法国公董局对人力车夫的登记

法国公董局于一个月前开始对公共人力车夫进行登记。然而截至目前，由于车主和车夫的强烈反对，尚无一名人力车夫登记。法国公董局现在提议自8月1日起取缔所有车夫未登记的人力车。两天前，理事会就此事项请求上海市政府提供协助。
7月31日，由时长生 (Sz Zang Sun) 率领的约40名人力车夫代表前往位于普育东路 (Poo Yeeh Tung Road) 三民坊 (San Min Faung) 24号的南市人力车主协会，声明人力车夫一致反对法国公董局的登记。车夫们将于8月1日再次提交申诉。
法租界的人力车主将于今日举行会议讨论局势。
某位人力车主代表昨日接受本报记者采访时发表了以下声明：“人力车夫的登记将由车夫自己决定。大多数车夫是无知的农民，不理解登记的含义。前段时间，由于引入登记制度，许多人力车夫返回乡下，人力车主的生意受到严重影响。后来人力车主保证不会进行车夫登记，此事才得以解决。如果最终实行登记，人力车夫将再次返回乡下

July 31, 1935. Morning Translation.

Shanghai Morning Post and other local newspapers:

OPPOSITION TO THE REGISTRATION OF RICSHA COOLIES BY THE
FRENCH MUNICIPAL COUNCIL

The French Municipal Council will enforce
the compulsory registration of public ricsha coolies as
from August 1. Both ricsha owners and coolies are opposing
registration.
At 9 a.m. yesterday three representatives of
the Ricsha Owners' Association, accompanied by Yuen Hung
Chin (阮鴻鈞), delegate of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce,
called on the French Municipal Police and submitted an
appeal.
The Director and the Deputy Director of the
French Police Service, who received the callers, declared
that the demand of the ricsha owners for a suspension of
the registration of ricsha coolies could not be entertained
and that a compromise over other questions could be
discussed after the ricsha owners have agreed to the
registration of coolies.
The representatives of ricsha owners said
that owners could not compel the coolies to register.
No satisfactory result was reached during
the negotiations. There will be no chance of the dispute
being solved if the two sides resort to extremes.

Crystal (晶報), a mosquito paper, published the following
article on July 30:-

THE POLICING OF THE EXTRA-SETTLEMENT ROADS

Through the efforts of Mayor Wu Te Chen, the
extra-Settlement roads question is nearing solution. The
area of the outside roads is one and a half times greater
than that of the Settlement. The outside roads in the
Northern District cover some 1,700 mow of land, while those
in the Western District have an area of 45,840 mow. A
Special Police Force will be established with a Commissioner
(Chinese) and two Deputy Commissioners (British and Japanese).
It is learned that great care is being
exercised in the selection of a Chinese Commissioner for
the Special Police Force in the extra-Settlement roads
area, as he must be a person of good reputation and wide
knowledge and have the confidence of the public. A suitable
candidate would be any returned Chinese student from
England to be the Chinese Commissioner because most of
the negotiations will be with the British. The authorities
have suggested that Mr. Kum, Assistant Municipal Advocate
of the S.M.C., be appointed to the post.
Mr. Kum is the son of a well known scholar
and his elder brother was compradore of the Shanghai &
Hongkew Wharf Company for a number of years. Mr. Kum
is a returned student from England where he studied law.
As an Assistant Municipal Advocate of the S.M.C. he is
respected by foreigners.

《上海晨报》及其他本地报纸：

反对法国公董局对人力车夫的登记

法国公董局将自8月1日起强制实施公共人力车夫登记。车主和车夫均反对登记。
昨日上午9时，人力车主协会的三名代表在中国商会代表阮鸿钧 (Yuen Hung Chin) 的陪同下，拜访法国市政警察并提交申诉。
接待来访者的法国警务处处长和副处长声明，人力车主要求暂停人力车夫登记的请求不予考虑，只有在人力车主同意车夫登记后，才能讨论其他问题的妥协方案。
人力车主代表表示，车主无法强迫车夫登记。
谈判未取得满意结果。如果双方走向极端，纠纷将没有解决的机会。

小报《晶报》于7月30日刊登了以下文章：-

越界筑路的警务管理

通过吴铁城市长的努力，越界筑路问题即将得到解决。越界筑路区域的面积是租界面积的一倍半。北区的越界筑路占地约1,700亩，而西区的面积为45,840亩。将建立一支特别警察部队，设一名总监（中国人）和两名副总监（英国人和日本人）。
据悉，在选拔越界筑路区域特别警察部队的一名中国总监时非常谨慎，因为他必须是一个声誉良好、知识渊博并获得公众信任的人。合适的候选人将是任何留英归国学生担任中国总监，因为大多数谈判将与英国人进行。当局建议任命工部局助理市政律师金先生 (Mr. Kum) 担任此职。
金先生是一位著名学者的儿子，他的长兄曾多年担任上海及虹口码头公司 (Shanghai & Hongkew Wharf Company) 的买办。金先生是留英归国学生，在那里学习法律。作为工部局的助理市政律师，他受到外国人的尊重。

Nantao-Frenchtown Ricshas - Owners and coolies oppose
licensing of coolies by the C.M.F.

At 10 a.m. July 30, three representatives of the
Nantao Office of the Shanghai Municipality Public Ricsha
Owners' Association called at French Police Headquarters
and requested the cancellation of the decision to license
ricsha pullers. The request was refused.

During the same forenoon two other delegates of the

held a tiffin party in the Hung Yuin Lur Restaurant, 110
Dah Shing Ke, Nantao. Apart from resolving to persist
in the opposition, they decided to request the owners and
pullers of ricshas bearing French Concession licences
and operating in Siccawei and vicinity to join the movement.

July 30, 1935. Morning Translation.

Shanghai Morning Post and other local newspapers:

OPPOSITION TO THE REGISTRATION OF RICSHA COOLIES IN THE
FRENCH CONCESSION

There are some 17,000 public ricshas in the
French Concession and 50,000 to 60,000 coolies depend on
the pulling of ricshas as a means of livelihood. In view
of the fact that the authorities of the International
Settlement are registering ricsha coolies, the French
Municipal Council has also started a similar registration.
But the ricsha coolies in the French Concession are opposing
registration. The French Municipal Council has, therefore,
issued a notice stating that compulsory registration of
public ricsha coolies will be commenced as from August 1.
The ricsha coolies of the French Concession
held a meeting on the afternoon of July 28 on a piece of
vacant ground at Nan Moc Dau (南碼頭), Nantao. Some 90
representatives of ricsha coolies were present. Sz Zang
Sun (時長生) presided.
The following resolutions were discussed and
passed:-
1) That registration of public ricsha coolies in the
French Concession be unanimously opposed.
2) That representatives be elected to submit an appeal to
the Ricsha Owners' Association.

At 9 a.m. yesterday, five representatives of
ricsha coolies called at the Ricsha Owners' Association
at San Min Faung (三民坊) and presented an appeal.
The representatives stated that ricsha coolies
in the French Concession were opposing registration and
that the coolies were prepared to give up the pulling of
ricshas in the event of the owners compelling the coolies
to register.
Soong Yao Kwen (宋堯坤), member of the Association,
promised to give them a reply later.

At 10 a.m. yesterday, three representatives of
the Ricsha Owners' Association called at the Chinese Chamber
of Commerce. The representatives stated that the French
Municipal Council is placing upon ricsha owners the
responsibility for the registration of ricsha coolies and
that the Council had threatened to detain all ricshas
the pullers of which are unregistered. The representatives
said that ricsha owners were not in a position to undertake
the responsibility.

Yuen Hung Chin (袁鴻鈞) of the Chamber of
Commerce replied that representatives of the Chamber would
call on the French Municipal Council on July 30 together
with the representatives of ricsha owners and request
the Council to change its plan for the registration of
ricsha coolies.

The Ricsha Owners' Association has elected
three representatives to call on the French Municipal
Council with the representatives of the Chinese Chamber
of Commerce on the morning of July 30 to submit an appeal.

《上海晨报》及其他本地报纸：

反对法租界人力车夫登记

法租界约有公用人力车17,000辆，依靠拉车谋生的车夫达50,000至60,000人。鉴于国际租界当局正在对人力车夫进行登记，法公董局也开始了类似的登记工作。但法租界的人力车夫反对登记。因此，法公董局发布通告，声明自8月1日起开始强制登记公用人力车夫。
法租界人力车夫于7月28日下午在南市南码头的一块空地上举行会议。约90名车夫代表出席。时长生主持。
讨论并通过以下决议：
1) 一致反对法租界公用人力车夫的登记。
2) 选举代表向人力车车主协会提交请愿书。

昨日上午9时，五名车夫代表前往三民坊人力车车主协会并提交请愿书。
代表们表示，法租界的人力车夫反对登记，如果车主强迫车夫登记，车夫们准备放弃拉车。
协会成员宋尧坤答应稍后给予答复。

昨日上午10时，人力车车主协会的三名代表拜访了中国商会。代表们称，法公董局将人力车夫登记的责任强加给车主，并威胁要扣留所有车夫未登记的人力车。代表们表示，车主无力承担此责任。

商会袁鸿钧回复称，商会代表将于7月30日会同人力车车主代表拜访法公董局，请求公董局改变人力车夫登记计划。

人力车车主协会已选出三名代表，将于7月30日上午随同中国商会代表拜访法公董局，提交请愿书。

Nantao-Frenchtown Public Ricshas - owners and

经查，这些车夫是受车主指使，对法租界车夫领照一事进行反对。

of the same Code. Article 368 stipulates that no appeal is allowed from a judgment given at the second trial for the crimes mentioned in Article 61 of the Criminal Code. If this application is correct, an accused will not be allowed to appeal from the decision rendered in the second trial. Then of what use is the Court of third trial? How is the word "procedure" to be explained? The object of the special restrictions mentioned in Article 368 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in the cases of crimes mentioned in Article 61 of the Criminal Code is to avoid trivial cases being passed to the Court of third trial or to the Supreme Court. The three-hearing system is the basis of the Chinese Criminal Code. The conclusion of a case after two trials is exceptional. No law system of any civilized country contains such a stipulation, namely, that a case is to be completed after one trial without appeal. The Second Branch Kiangsu High Court says that there is such a stipulation in the Code of Criminal Procedure of the Republic of China. This Association declines to believe that this is true.
This Association has held a meeting to discuss the case of Doo Zoong Yuen. The opinion was general that the decision of the Second Branch Kiangsu High Court in this case is illegal and will work grave harm to Chinese law. Therefore, the Association can not remain silent.
The Association hereby requests the Judicial Yuan to instruct the Second Branch Kiangsu High Court to rectify its mistake and to notify all Courts in the country to conform with the law so as to uphold justice and to protect the rights of the people.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers

THE REGISTRATION OF RICSHA COOLIES IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION

The French Municipal Council has issued a warning to the effect that compulsory registration of public ricsha coolies will be commenced as from August 1 and in the event of the coolies continuing to oppose registration, ricshas will be detained and will not be allowed to operate in the French Concession.
Considering that the authorities of the International Settlement had never taken such a strong step, ricsha coolies in the French Concession will hold a meeting to-day to discuss the matter.
In view of the fact that the opposition to registration is a voluntary action on the part of the coolies, and as the authorities of the French Concession are forcibly oppressing ricsha owners, all owners of ricshas holding licences to operate in the French Concession will hold a meeting in a day or two to discuss the situation.

同一法典之规定。第368条规定，对于刑法第61条所述之罪行，二审判决不得上诉。若此适用正确，被告将不被允许对二审裁决提出上诉。那么三审法院有何用处？“程序”一词应如何解释？刑事诉讼法第368条针对刑法第61条所述罪行案件中的特别限制，其目的是避免琐碎案件移送至三审法院或最高法院。三审制是中国刑法的基础。两审结案属例外情况。任何文明国家的法律体系中均无此类规定，即案件经一次审判且不得上诉即告终结。江苏高等法院第二分院称，中华民国刑事诉讼法中有此规定。本会不信此为真。
本会已召开会议讨论杜宗元案。普遍意见认为，江苏高等法院第二分院在此案中的裁决违法，并将对中国法律造成严重损害。因此，本会不能保持沉默。
本会特此请求司法院指令江苏高等法院第二分院纠正其错误，并通知全国各法院依法行事，以维护正义并保护人民权利。

China Times and other local newspapers:-

THE STRIKE OF RICSHA COOLIES IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION

The situation in the strike of ricsha
coolies in the French Concession remained unchanged
yesterday. Under pressure from t he Kuomintang and
official organs, the coolies have decided to resume
operations in Nantao.

The Bureau of Social Affairs yesterday
summoned to its office Yu. Dah Ching (于達全), Zeu
Tsung San (仇春山), and Tsang Wai Yang (張偉揚),
representatives of the ricsha owners. They were
informed by Wong Kong (王剛), a staff member of the
Bureau, of the following two measures devised by the
Shanghai City Government to deal with the dispute:-
1) The Shanghai City Government will take
up the negotiations with the French Authorities.
Ricsha owners and coolies should wait quietly for a
decision by the City Government.
2) The Bureau of Social Affairs will
notify ricsha coolies, through the ricsha owners,
to resume work on August 9.

The local Kuomintang Headquarters and the
Bureau of Social Affairs have each issued a notice
instructing the Ricsha Owners' Association to persuade
the coolies to resume work forthwith pending negotiations
by the Authorities.

At 3 p.m. August 8, twenty committee members
of the Ricsha Owners' Association held a meeting at
their office on Pu Yoeh Tung Road, Nantao, and decided
to instruct coolies to resume work in compliance with
the order of the Kuomintang and official organs.

About 200 ricsha coolies held a meeting at
5 p.m. August 8 at Nan Ma Deu (南碼頭), Nantao Bund.
The instructions of ricsha owners to the
coolies ordering them to resume work were discussed
and the following resolutions passed:-
1) That work be resumed on the morning of
August 9 in Nantao only. No coolies will be allowed
to operate in the French Concession.
2) That the Ricsha Owners' Association be
requested to negotiate with the French Authorities for
compensation for losses sustained by owners and coolies
during the strike.
3) That the French Police pay the medical
expenses of the ricsha coolies who were injured during
the trouble on the morning of August 6.
4) That the French Police be asked to
produce the missing ricsha coolie named Sih San (施三).

法租界人力车夫罢工

昨日，法租界人力车夫罢工局势保持不变。在国民党及官方机构的压力下，车夫们已决定在南市恢复运营。

社会局昨日传召人力车车主代表于達全（Yu. Dah Ching）、仇春山（Zeu Tsung San）和張偉揚（Tsang Wai Yang）到局办公。该局职员王剛（Wong Kong）向他们通报了上海市政府为解决此次纠纷所制定的两项措施：-
1) 上海市政府将与法国当局进行谈判。人力车车主和车夫应静候市政府的决定。
2) 社会局将通过人力车车主通知人力车夫于8月9日复工。

当地国民党党部和社会局分别发布通告，指示人力车业主公会劝告车夫在当局谈判期间立即复工。

8月8日下午3时，人力车业主公会的二十名委员在南市蒲东路（Pu Yoeh Tung Road）的会所举行会议，决定遵照国民党和官方机构的命令，指示车夫复工。

8月8日下午5时，约200名人力车夫在南市外滩南碼頭（Nan Ma Deu）举行会议。会上讨论了车主关于令车夫复工的指示，并通过以下决议：-
1) 仅于8月9日上午在南市复工。不允许任何车夫在法租界内运营。
2) 请人力车业主公会与法国当局谈判，赔偿车主和车夫在罢工期间遭受的损失。
3) 要求法国警察支付8月6日上午骚乱中受伤人力车夫的医疗费用。
4) 要求法国警方交出在骚乱中失踪的名叫施三（Sih San）的人力车夫。

August 9, 1935. Morning translation.

In an interview with a reporter of this paper yesterday, a representative of the ricsha coolies pointed out that the view of the French Consul-General reagrding registration of ricsha coolies is not quite reasonable. The coolies did not oppose registration by the S.M.C. because the licence plates of the ricshas in the Settlement are issued by the Council and the latter, therefore, has the right to control the vehicles. The Nantao ricshas carry licence plates issued by the Bureau of Public Utility and therefore are not under the control of the French Municipal Council. If the French Authorities desire to register the Nantao ricshas, they should also undertake the registration od Settlement vehicles. The French Authorities should not treat the ricshas of the two districts in a different manner.

On the afternoon of August 7, a boy named Koo Zang Shing ( ), sixteen years of age, was arrested on Rue Capitaine Rabier for removing valves form ricsha tyres. He was brought before Court on August 8 when he was sentenced to 20 days' detention, sentence to be suspended for two years.

本报代表昨日采访了一位人力车夫代表，该代表指出，法国总领事关于人力车夫登记的观点并不完全合理。车夫们并不反对由工部局（S.M.C.）进行登记，因为租界内人力车的牌照是由公董局颁发的，因此公董局有权管理这些车辆。南市的人力车悬挂的是公用局颁发的牌照，因此不受法国公董局的管辖。如果法国当局希望登记南市的人力车，他们也应当承担起对租界车辆的登记工作。法国当局不应以不同的方式对待这两个地区的人力车。

8月7日下午，一名名叫顾张兴（Koo Zang Shing ( )）的十六岁男孩因拆卸人力车轮胎气门芯而在拉比埃船长路（Rue Capitaine Rabier）被捕。他于8月8日被提堂，被判拘留二十天，缓刑两年执行。

Meeting in Chamber of Commerce

About 400 ricsha owners held a general meeting
in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce at 8 a.m. yesterday.
Zi Hung Sung (徐鴻生), Tseu Li (周禮), and Wu Nyi Kao
(吳義高), representing the ricsha coolies, Ching Zang
Ling (金章林), representing the Special District Office
of the Ricsha Owners' Association and Li Zu Tsang (李祖),
representing the Chinese Chamber of Commerce were present.
Zeu Tsung San, Koo Soong Mur and three others formed the
presidium.
Zeu made a report on the negotiations with
the French Municipal Council. Koo Soong Mur and Li
Zu Tsang also spoke.

The following information was released by the
French Police on August 7:-
"There is no change in the situation arising
over the registration of ricsha coolies. Quiet prevails.
"At 8 a.m. August 7 the Nantao ricsha owners
held a meeting in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
Zau Pei Z (曹沛滋), representing the Tangpu, Tsang Dah
Fu (張達夫), representing the Bureau of Social Affairs,
and Zung Kuo Liang (陳國樑), who claims to be the
representative of ricsha coolies were present.
"Yesterday (?August 6) a section of the Nantao
ricsha owners decided to register with the French
Authorities.
"On the same day (?August 6) a large number
of loafers in Nantao in groups of 15 or 20 deflated tyres
of ricshas bearing French Concession licences. Similar
activities were carried out by them in the French
Concession. The ringleader of the movement has been
arrested and will be charged in Court.
"The French Police are paying special attention
to the reports published in local newspapers in connection
with the dispute and will refute inaccurate reports.
As regards the trouble in the early morning of August 6,
the French Police can produce evidence to show that the
policemen did not fire on the crowd but were obliged
to fire three blank shots into the air."

Journal de Shanghai:-
French Police and False Newspaper Reports

No serious incidents occurred throughout
yesterday.
At the meeting held at 8 a.m. yesterday in the
Chamber of Commerce on North Honan Road, there were
present a number of ricsha owners and certain individuals
posing as representatives of ricsha pullers but
who are in fact notorious professional agitators,
particularly the man named Chen Kuo Liang (we remember
the part he played when the decisions of the Ricsha
Board of the International Settlement were being enforced).
Others present were Chao Pei Tsu of the Tangpu, Chang
Dah Fu of the Social Bureau and Li Zu Tsang of the Chamber
of Commerce. Zeu Tsung San of the Ricsha Owners' Association
of Nantao presided.

1935年8月8日。晨间译件。

商会会议

昨天上午8时，约400名人力车车主在中国商会举行全体会议。代表人力车夫的徐鴻生（Zi Hung Sung）、周禮（Tseu Li）和吳義高（Wu Nyi Kao），代表人力车业主公会特区办事处的金章林（Ching Zang Ling），以及代表中国商会的李祖（Li Zu Tsang）出席了会议。仇春山（Zeu Tsung San）、顾松茂（Koo Soong Mur）和其他三人组成主席团。
仇春山汇报了与法国公董局的谈判情况。顾松茂和李祖也发了言。

法国警察于8月7日发布如下信息：-
“人力车夫登记引发的局势没有变化。局面平静。
“8月7日上午8时，南市人力车车主在中国商会举行会议。代表塘浦的曹沛滋（Zau Pei Z）、代表社会局的張達夫（Tsang Dah Fu）以及自称代表人力车夫的陳國樑（Zung Kuo Liang）出席了会议。
“昨天（?8月6日），部分南市人力车车主决定向法国当局登记。
“同日（?8月6日），南市的大量游手好闲之徒分成15或20人的小组，放掉悬挂法租界牌照的人力车的轮胎气。他们在法租界内也进行了类似的活动。该运动的头目已被逮捕，并将被起诉。
“法国警察正特别注意本地报纸上发表的与此次纠纷有关的报道，并将驳斥不实的报道。关于8月6日凌晨的骚乱，法国警察可以提供证据表明，警察并未向人群开枪，而是被迫向空中发射了三发空包弹。”

《上海日报》（Journal de Shanghai）：-
法国警察与虚假报纸报道

昨天全天未发生严重事件。
在昨天上午8时于北河南路商会举行的会议上，出席者包括许多人力车车主和一些自称是人力车夫代表但实际上是臭名昭著的职业煽动者的人，特别是名叫陳國梁（Chen Kuo Liang）的人（我们记得他在执行国际租界人力车董事会决定时所扮演的角色）。其他出席者包括来自塘浦的赵佩祖（Chao Pei Tsu）、来自社会局的张达夫（Chang Dah Fu）和来自商会的李祖棠（Li Zu Tsang）。由南市人力车业主公会的仇春山（Zeu Tsung San）主持。

August 8, 1935.
Morning Translation.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 5670 Date ... / ... / ...）

During the meeting, the French Police and the Shanghai Municipal Police were violently attacked.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1) That Ministry of Foreign Affairs be requested to open negotiations with the French Legation over the registration of ricsha coolies.
2) That the culprits be punished.
3) That an apology be demanded from the French Concession Authorities.
4) That an assurance be given by the French Authorities that fresh incidents will not occur in future.
5) That an appeal for assistance be issued to all classes of society.
It is reported that at noon yesterday a number of ricsha owners of Nantao decided to accept registration.

Groups of 15 to 20 loafers are roaming about in Nantao and when they see a ricsha provided with French licence they remove the valves of the tyres. One man was arrested in the French Concession for removing valves and was charged in the 2nd Special District Court for interfering with freedom to work, contrary to the Chinese Criminal Code.

The French Police Authorities are protesting energetically against the tendacious and manifestly false reports published by certain Chinese newspapers yesterday morning regarding the incidents which occurred on August 6.
These reports are intended to mislead public opinion and to create discord. The French Police make a flat denial of these reports.
Furthermore, the French Police declare positively that none of the Annamite Policemen on duty on the boundary of the Concession near St. Catherine's Bridge had opened fire at the crowd nor had any officers of the Special Brigade sent out reinforcements from Poste Centrale done so. It was only when the Annamite Policemen had been over-run by a crowd of 600 to 700 demonstrators, mostly loafers or professional agitators, and were being treated with revolting brutality that the Annamite Policemen fired three shots into the air with their carbines. The weapons were charged with blank cartridges.

1935年8月8日。
晨间译件。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别分部登记处。编号 D 5670 日期 ... / ... / ...）

会议期间，法国警察和上海公共租界警察遭到猛烈攻击。
通过以下决议：-
1) 请外交部就人力车夫登记问题与法国公使馆开启谈判。
2) 惩办凶手。
3) 要求法租界当局道歉。
4) 要求法国当局保证今后不再发生新的事件。
5) 向社会各界发出援助呼吁。
据报道，昨天中午，一批南市人力车车主决定接受登记。

成群结队（15至20人）的游手好闲之徒在南市游荡，一旦看到悬挂法国牌照的人力车，便拆下轮胎的气门芯。一人因拆卸气门芯在法租界被捕，并以违反《中华民国刑法》、干涉工作自由为由在第二特区地方法院被起诉。

法国警察当局强烈抗议某些中文报纸昨天早晨发表的关于8月6日事件的带有倾向性且明显虚假的报道。
这些报道旨在误导公众舆论并制造不和。法国警察断然否认这些报道。
此外，法国警察明确声明，在圣凯瑟琳桥附近租界边界执勤的任何安南警察均未向人群开枪，从中央巡捕房派出增援部队的特别班任何警官也未开枪。只有当600至700名示威者（大多是游手好闲之徒或职业煽动者）冲垮安南警察防线，并以令人发指的残暴手段对待他们时，安南警察才用卡宾枪向空中发射了三发子弹。武器装填的是空包弹。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5670.
Date 8 / 8 / 35.

August 8, 1935.    2    Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:-

THE STRIKE OF RICSHA COOLIES IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION

The strike of 40,000 ricsha coolies in the French Concession was still in progress yesterday. No Settlement ricshas would enter Nantao but confined their operations to the Settlement and French Concession for fear of deflation of their tyres.

Doo Yueh Sen had an interview with M. Baudez, the French Consul-General. During the interview, the Consul-General said that registration of ricsha coolies was first introduced by the S.M.C. and not by the French Authorities. The ricsha coolies, however, raised opposition against the plan of the French Authorities and engaged in riotous activities in the course of which they injured several Annamite policemen. The Consul-General declared that it would be very difficult to make any change in the plan of registration.

Doo Yueh Sen's suggestion for a settlement

At 9 p.m. August 6 the Ricsha Owners' Association detailed Koo Soong Mur (顧松茂), Yu Ching Dah (于慶大), Tsang Wai Yang (張衛揚) and Zeu Tsung San (祝宗山) to call on Doo Yueh Sen at his residence. Doo informed them of his call on the French Consul-General and reported that the French official was very displeased over the assault on the Annamite policemen by the ricsha coolies. Doo also stated that he would endeavour to secure a solution of the trouble provided that for every ricsha one coolie be first registered with the C.M.F.
The callers agreed to lay the suggestion before a meeting of ricsha owners.

The ricsha coolie named Sih San (施三), who disappeared during the trouble on the morning of August 6, is still missing. The two Annamite policemen Nos. 223 and 173 who sustained serious injuries are still being detained in hospital. Annamite policeman No.480 who was slightly injured during the trouble has left hospital.

The three ricsha coolies who were arrested by the French Police during the trouble on August 6 were brought before the 2nd Special District Court on August 7 when the case against them was remanded to August 14.

Four coolies who were arrested in the French Concession for deflating the tyres of ricshas on August 6 were charged in Court on August 7. After an interrogation, the Judge remanded the case till August 10.

The general public are paying special attention to the dispute because it affects communication. Mayor Wu has instructed the Bureau of Social Affairs to make a thorough investigation into the trouble; he has also instructed the ricsha coolies to observe order.

1935年8月8日。    2    晨间译件。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：-

法租界人力车夫罢工

法租界四万名人力车夫的罢工昨日仍在进行中。出于担心轮胎被放气，没有公共租界的人力车进入南市，其运营范围仅限于公共租界和法租界。

杜月笙会见了法国总领事鲍德兹（Baudez）先生。会谈期间，总领事表示，人力车夫注册制度最初是由工部局（S.M.C.）引入的，而非法国当局。然而，人力车夫对法国当局的计划提出反对，并在过程中从事骚乱活动，致使数名安南籍巡捕受伤。总领事宣称，很难对注册计划做出任何更改。

杜月笙提出的解决方案建议

8月6日晚9时，人力车车主协会派遣顾松茂、于庆大、张卫扬和祝宗山前往杜月笙寓所拜访。杜告知他们自己已拜会法国总领事，并转达该法国官员对人力车夫袭击安南籍巡捕一事深感不满。杜还表示，如果每辆人力车先有一名车夫在法公董局（C.M.F.）注册，他将努力寻求解决此次纠纷的办法。
来访者同意将此建议提交给人力车车主会议审议。

在8月6日上午的骚乱中失踪的名叫施三的人力车夫，目前仍下落不明。受重伤的两名安南籍巡捕（编号223和173）仍留院治疗。在骚乱中受轻伤的安南籍巡捕（编号480）已出院。

法国警方在8月6日骚乱期间逮捕的三名人力车夫，于8月7日被提审至第二特区地方法院，针对他们的案件被延期至8月14日审理。

四名因在8月6日于法租界放掉人力车轮胎而被捕的车夫，于8月7日被起诉至法院。经讯问后，法官将案件延期至8月10日审理。

公众因该纠纷影响交通而格外关注。吴市长已指示社会局对此次事件进行彻底调查；他还指示人力车夫遵守秩序。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. REGISTRY.
No. D 5670
Date 8 / 8 . 1 3 5

August 8, 1935. Morning Translation.

The Shanghai Public Daily News (市民日报) published
the following comment on August 7 :-

Chinese Newspaper Comment

As a protest against compulsory registration
by the French Concession Authorities, the 24,000 ricsha
coolies in the Concession have gone on strike and 7,000
ricshas are now idle. The other day, a body of over
1,000 ricsha coolies, who desired to enter the French
Concession to make an appeal, came into conflict with
over 100 armed Annamite policemen of the French Police
at the iron gates near St. Catherine's Bridge which is
on the boundary between the French Concession and
Chinese controlled territory. During the clash over
10 ricsha coolies were injured and the situation became
very serious.

The general public are paying close attention
to the dispute. Prior to the clash between the Annamite
policemen and ricsha coolies attempts at mediation were
made by the local Tangpu and other political organs and
by Doo Yuet Seng but the French Authorities were very
firm and refused to make any change in their plan for
the registration of ricsha coolies. In consequence
the coolies went on strike. The French Authorities
should be held responsible for the incident.

It is not known whether the firing at the
unarmed coolies by the Annamite policemen had been
carried out at the instructions of the French Authorities
or at the initiative of the Annamite policemen themselves.
The coolies desired to appeal for the abolition
of the registration. They were not doing anything
unlawful which would affect the peace and order of the
Concession and the Annamite policemen should not have
treated them as desperadoes and opened fire at them.
Furthermore, when the coolies withdrew, the Annamite
policemen should not have entered Chinese controlled
territory to arrest three of the coolies. Their action
constitutes a violation of the regulations and it will
not only affect diplomatic relations between China and
France, but is a blemish on the reputation of the French
Police.

We hope the French Authorities will hereafter
control their subordinates more strictly so that similar
incidents will not occur again. The offending policemen
should be punished as a warning to others.

The registration of coolies which is being
insisted upon by the French Authorities but which is being
energetically opposed by the coolies should be cancelled.

Shanghai Morning Post and other local newspapers

Maintenance of Original Ricsha Type Requested

The ricsha owners in the Special District sent
the following petition to the S.M.C. yesterday requesting
that the original type of public ricsha be maintained:-
"Loh Teh Shing (罗德馨), Chang Zing Poo (张静波)"

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别管理处登记处。
编号 D 5670
日期 35年8月8日

1935年8月8日。晨间译件。

《市民日报》于8月7日刊登了以下评论：-

中文报纸评论

为抗议法租界当局的强制注册，租界内的24,000名人力车夫举行罢工，导致7,000辆人力车闲置。日前，一批超过1,000名希望进入法租界请愿的人力车夫，在位于法租界与中国管辖区域边界的圣凯瑟琳桥附近的铁门处，与100多名全副武装的法国警方安南籍巡捕发生冲突。在冲突中，超过10名人力车夫受伤，局势变得非常严峻。

公众密切关注这一纠纷。在安南籍巡捕与人力车夫发生冲突之前，本地塘浦及其他政治团体以及杜月笙曾尝试调解，但法国当局态度非常强硬，拒绝对其人力车夫注册计划做任何更改。因此，车夫们举行了罢工。法国当局应对此事件负责。

目前尚不清楚安南籍巡捕向手无寸铁的车夫开枪是奉法国当局之命，还是安南籍巡捕自行发起的行动。车夫们希望请求废除注册制度。他们并未从事任何会影响租界和平与秩序的违法行为，安南籍巡捕不应将他们视为亡命之徒并向其开火。此外，当车夫撤退时，安南籍巡捕不应进入中国管辖区域逮捕其中三名车夫。他们的行为构成违规，这不仅会影响中法外交关系，也是法国警方声誉上的污点。

我们希望法国当局今后更严格地管束其下属，以免类似事件再次发生。肇事巡捕应受到惩罚，以儆效尤。

法国当局坚持推行但遭到车夫强烈反对的车夫注册制度应予取消。

《上海晨报》及其他本地报纸

要求保留原有类型的人力车

特区的人力车车主昨日向工部局递交了以下请愿书，请求保留原有类型的公共人力车：-
“罗德馨，张静波”

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5670.
Date 7 / 8 / 35

August 7, 1935.
2. Afternoon Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

ANTI-CHINESE MOVEMENT IN SIAM

At a recent meeting held by the Federation of the Various Public Bodies in Shanghai to support Overseas Chinese in Siam, it was resolved that letters be sent to the various public bodies in Hongkong, Kwangtung, Fokien, Swatow, and Amoy, requesting them to detail delegates to participate in a mass meeting which will be called in the near future to discuss measures for the formation of a National Federation to Support Overseas Chinese in Siam.

The following is an abridged translation of the letter :-

"After the adoption of an anti-Chinese movement by the Siamese Government, this Federation has been soliciting the assistance of local rice dealers to enforce a boycott of Siamese rice. This action has resulted in the complete removal of Siamese rice from the local market. However, the Siamese Government is very obstinate. Not only has it failed to accord better treatment to Chinese in Siam, but it has enforced stricter disciplinary measures against them.

"This Federation has decided to seek the cooperation of various public bodies throughout this country and request your Association (? name) to send representatives to a conference to discuss the formation of a National Federation to Support Overseas Chinese in Siam."

"AN UNFORTUNATE INCIDENT"

Commenting on the shooting incident at St. Catherine's Bridge, the "Shanghai Morning Post" (official organ of General Chiang Kai Shek) writes:-

The French Municipal Council is enforcing the compulsory registration of ricsha coolies for which a registration fee of $1.50 (? 50 cents) per ricsha is being charged. Two-thirds of the fee is to be borne by the ricsha owner, the balance by the coolie. Ricsha owners and coolies are not in a position to pay such a fee at this time of trade depression and have demanded that the fee be abolished. The French Police rejected the demand and began to seize ricshas. The mediation offered by Doo Yueh Seng having failed, the ricsha coolies went on a general strike.

On the morning of August 6, over 1,000 ricsha coolies desired to submit an appeal to the French Police but the armed policemen of the French Police fired 18 shots, wounding 12 ricsha coolies. The French Police arrested the coolies by encroaching on Chinese controlled territory.

There are 10,000 ricshas operating in the French Concession. In all some 100,000 persons in Shanghai depend on the ricsha as a means of livelihood. The living of the ricsha coolie is most precarious,

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处。
编号 D 5670。
日期 35年8月7日

1935年8月7日。
2. 午后译件。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：-

暹罗的反华运动

在上海各团体联合会最近举行的支持暹罗华侨会议上，决议向香港、广东、福建、汕头和厦门的各团体致函，请求它们派遣代表参加即将召开的群众大会，讨论组建“全国支持暹罗华侨联合会”的措施。

以下是信函的节译：-

“暹罗政府采取反华运动后，本联合会一直恳请本地米商协助抵制暹罗米。此举导致暹罗米完全从本地市场消失。然而，暹罗政府非常顽固。它不仅未能改善在暹罗华人的待遇，反而对他们实施了更严厉的纪律措施。

“本联合会决定寻求全国各团体的合作，并请求贵协会（？名称）派代表参加会议，讨论组建‘全国支持暹罗华侨联合会’事宜。”

“一起不幸的事件”

《上海晨报》（蒋介石将军的官方喉舌）就圣凯瑟琳桥枪击事件评论道：-

法市政委员会正在强制执行人力车夫强制注册，每辆人力车收取1.50美元（？50美分）的注册费。费用的三分之二由人力车车主承担，其余由车夫承担。在商业萧条时期，人力车车主和车夫无力支付如此费用，并要求免除该费用。法国警方拒绝了这一要求，并开始扣押人力车。由于杜月笙提供的调解失败，人力车夫举行了总罢工。

8月6日上午，超过1,000名人力车夫希望向法国警方提交请愿书，但法国警方的武装巡捕开了18枪，打伤12名人力车夫。法国警方通过侵入中国管辖区域逮捕了车夫。

法租界内有10,000辆人力车在运营。总之，上海约有100,000人依靠人力车谋生。人力车夫的生活最为 precarious（原文不清/危如累卵），

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D_______
Date ___/___/___

3
August 7, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

while the treatment accorded to the coolies by the Settlement Authorities and the general public is too harsh.
The action of the French Authorities in compelling ricsha coolies to register has given rise to an unfortunate incident. The ricsha owners desire a compromise, but the French Authorities are adamant. The unarmed coolies desired to submit an appeal. If the French Authorities were afraid that untoward incidents might arise, they should have adopted precautionary measures or given peaceful advice to the coolies. Should the French Authorities give the pretext that the number of coolies was very great and could not be controlled, then reasonable measures (such as turning a stream of water on the coolies, etc.) could have been used to disperse them. No civilized government in the world would unreasonably open fire in broad daylight on an unarmed people who desire to make an appeal in a peaceful manner. If the French Authorities can not prove that the peaceful coolies were bent on creating a disturbance of the peace and order or to create an uprising, then they must shoulder the responsibility for the illegal shooting. The sacred constitution observed by the French people says:- "A person is born with freedom and equal treatment" and "The rights of a person are bestowed upon him by heaven". The ricsha coolie may be an inferior in the social scale, but he has the same legal rights as any other resident of Shanghai. This insult to the ricsha coolies and the shooting incident concern all residents in the foreign Settlements.
The Chinese Authorities are discussing proper measures to deal with the affair in which the French Police had arrested coolies by entering Chinese controlled territory.
The ricsha coolies are demanding the abolition of registration, the punishment of the culprits and the payment of compensation.
We hope the French Consul-General will at once adopt fair and effective measures to deal with the present unfortunate incident so that the Chinese people, who are anxious to maintain good relations between China and France, may not be given any cause to doubt the fairness of the French Authorities.

The Holmes (福摩斯), a mosquito paper, dated August 6 :-
In former days ricshas were a useful means of communication but to-day they are obstacles to traffic in this growing city.
During the hot weather, ricsha coolies have to run like horses under the strong sun and sometimes they receive ill-treatment. What they earn is usually insufficient for their living.
There are many places which are not served by the tram and bus. Then by what means are people, who do not own motor cars, to reach these places?
Ricsha pulling is a very low class profession, but it saves the coolies from starvation. If ricshas are abolished, about 100,000 persons would be faced with starvation.

1935年8月7日。午后译件。

而租界当局和公众给予车夫的待遇过于严苛。
法国当局强迫人力车夫注册的行为引发了一起不幸的事件。人力车车主希望妥协，但法国当局态度坚决。手无寸铁的车夫希望提交请愿书。如果法国当局担心可能发生不测事件，本应采取预防措施或向车夫提供和平劝告。如果法国当局以车夫人数众多、无法控制为借口，那么本可以使用合理的措施（例如向车夫喷水等）来驱散他们。世界上没有任何文明政府会在光天化日之下，不合理地向以和平方式请愿的手无寸铁的人民开火。如果法国当局不能证明这些和平的车夫蓄意扰乱治安或制造叛乱，那么他们必须为非法射击承担责任。法国人民所尊崇的神圣宪法规定：“人生而自由且待遇平等”以及“人权天赋”。人力车夫在社会阶层中可能地位低下，但他拥有与上海任何其他居民相同的法律权利。这种对人力车夫的侮辱和枪击事件关系到所有外国租界的居民。
中国当局正在讨论适当措施，以处理法国警方进入中国管辖区域逮捕车夫一事。
人力车夫要求废除注册制度，惩办凶手，并支付赔偿。
我们希望法国总领事立即采取公平有效的措施来处理当前这起不幸事件，以免渴望维持中法良好关系的中国人民对法国当局的公正性产生任何怀疑。

8月6日的《福摩斯》（Holmes，一家小型报刊）：
过去，人力车是一种有用的交通工具，但如今在这个日益发展的城市中，它们已成为交通障碍。
在炎热天气里，人力车夫必须在烈日下像马匹一样奔跑，有时还会遭受虐待。他们的收入通常不足以维持生计。
有许多地方电车和公交车无法到达。那么，没有私家车的人们靠什么手段到达这些地方呢？
拉人力车是一种非常低贱的职业，但它使车夫免于饥饿。如果废除人力车，约100,000人将面临饥饿。

We are not opposed to the abolition of the
ricsha but prior to their abolition, the following
two points should be given serious consideration :-
(1) More means of communication should be provided for
and small hire cars should be used on narrow streets
to replace the ricsha.
(2) Adequate measures should be devised for the welfare
of the large number of coolies who will lose their
employment and they should be given work so that
they can support themselves and their dependants.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

BOAT BUILDING WORKERS IN POOTUNG

Owing to trade depression, the boat building
yards in Pootung have reduced the wages of each worker
by 15 cents a day from August 1.
Yesterday the Bureau of Social Affairs
summoned representatives of the employers and employees
to a meeting. As a result of mediation, it was
agreed that the wages be reduced by 4 cents a day.

The Iron News (铁报), a mosquito paper, publishes
the following article :-

THE PEACE IN THE FAR EAST

In his interview with Dr. Quo Tai Chi, Mr.
Litvinov, Chairman of the Council of the League of
Nations, expressed the opinion that peace in the Far
East could be secured if the Powers interested in
the Far East would co-operate closely.
We fully agree with Mr. Litvinov's
views, because the peace in the Far East can only be
maintained and protected by the Powers interested in
the Far East; our neighbour Japan should understand
this situation clearly.
China and Japan are the two principal nations
in the Far East. If the peace of these two nations is
assured, then the other interested Powers will not
create any trouble. It is only when the two principal
nations are at loggerheads that aggressions from out-
siders may arise. We sincerely hope that Japan
realizes this.

Sin Wan Pao dated August 6 :-

THE GREAT LIBRARY OF ZIKAVEI CHURCH TO BE OPENED
TO PUBLIC

The library of the Zikawei Church, which
came into existence 88 years ago, to-day contains
200,000 foreign and Chinese books. This is the
largest library in Shanghai but it is not available
to the public.
We understand that at the request of
intellectual circles, a large modern building will
be constructed in front of the Zikawei Church to house
the library. The cost is estimated at $100,000.
When the books are later removed into the new building
they will be available to the public.

我们并不反对废除人力车，但在废除之前，应认真考虑以下两点：
(1) 应提供更多交通方式，并在狭窄街道使用小型出租轿车以取代人力车。
(2) 应为大量将失业的苦力制定充分的福利措施，并为他们提供工作，使其能够养活自己及其受赡养人。

浦东造船工人

由于贸易萧条，自8月1日起，浦东各造船厂将每名工人的工资每日减少15分。
昨日，社会局召集雇主和雇员代表开会。经调解，双方同意将工资每日减少4分。

小报《铁报》刊登如下文章：

远东和平

国际联盟理事会主席李维诺夫先生在接受郭泰祺博士采访时表达的观点认为，如果关注远东事务的列强密切合作，就能确保远东和平。
我们完全同意李维诺夫先生的观点，因为远东和平只能由关注远东事务的列强来维持和保护；我们的邻国日本应清楚地了解这一局势。
中国和日本是远东的两个主要国家。如果这两个国家的和平得到保障，其他相关列强就不会制造麻烦。只有当这两个主要国家发生争执时，才可能引起外来的侵略。我们真诚希望日本认识到这一点。

8月6日《新闻报》：

徐家汇天主堂大图书馆将对公众开放

徐家汇天主堂图书馆成立于88年前，目前拥有中外书籍20万册。这是上海最大的图书馆，但不向公众开放。
据悉，应知识界要求，将在徐家汇天主堂前建造一座大型现代化建筑以容纳该图书馆。预计费用为10万美元。
待书籍日后迁入新楼后，将对公众开放。

August 7, 1935. Morning Translation.

Shanghai Morning Post and other local newspapers:

RICSHA COOLIES CREATE TROUBLE IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION

At 5 a.m. August 6, certain ricsha coolies in the French Concession attempted to instigate a general strike. Upon learning of this, the Police of the West Gate Branch of the Bureau of Public Safety advised the ricsha coolies not to go on strike.

At 9 a.m. the same day, over 1,000 ricsha coolies, who had come from Tso Zay Road (曹家渡), Loh Kia Pang Road (羅家浜路), the Great South Gate (大南門) and vicinity, proceeded towards the St. Catherine's Bridge with the intention of crossing into the French Concession to make an appeal to the French Police. The Chinese Police immediately dispatched a large party of policemen in an endeavour to prevent the coolies from proceeding further, but by the time the Chinese Police arrived the coolies had already reached St. Catherine's Bridge.

The French Authorities had, in the meantime, closed the iron gate between Chinese controlled territory and the French Concession at St. Catherine's Bridge and sent a party of French and Annamite policemen (100 in number) to keep guard at the iron gate. The ricsha coolies insisted on passing through the iron gate and a clash arose with the Annamite policemen. During the disorder, the Annamite policemen fired 18 shots and did their best to disperse the ricsha coolies. Upon seeing the policemen using their firearms, the coolies withdrew to Chinese controlled territory. The Annamite policemen rushed into Chinese controlled territory and then returned and securely closed the iron gate.

As a result of the clash, three Annamite policemen were injured and 12 ricsha coolies were wounded. Three pistols belong to Annamite policemen were lost. Subsequently, policemen of the West Gate Branch of the Public Safety Bureau picked up a pistol on Loh Kia Pang Road and another on Ling Ying Road (林路). The French Police sent deputies to the Public Safety Bureau and recovered these two pistols.

There were no ricshas operating yesterday in the French Concession and Nantao. A few ricshas bearing licences of the International Settlement which were seen operating in the French Concession had their tyres ripped off. The trams and buses at Nantao and in the French Concession did good business.

Fearing untoward incidents, the Chinese and the French Police Authorities are adopting strict precautionary measures.

After the clash, the Chinese Police removed the wounded ricsha coolies to the Shanghai Hospital (滬西醫院) at the San Tai Wharf (三泰碼頭) and the Nantao Hospital (滬南醫院) of the Bureau of Public Health. Five of the wounded coolies left after receiving treatment but two were removed by the French Police to the Red Cross Hospital. The condition of other wounded coolies is very serious.

《上海晨报》及其他本地报纸：

人力车苦力在法租界闹事

8月6日凌晨5时，法租界部分人力车苦力试图煽动总罢工。公共安全局西门分局警察获悉后，劝告人力车苦力不要罢工。

同日早上9时，来自曹家渡、羅家浜路、大南門及附近地区的一千多名人力车苦力向圣凯瑟琳桥进发，意图进入法租界向法国警察请愿。中国警察立即派遣大批警员，试图阻止苦力继续前进，但当中国警察到达时，苦力已抵达圣凯瑟琳桥。

与此同时，法国当局关闭了中国管辖区域与法租界之间位于圣凯瑟琳桥的铁门，并派出一队法国和安南警察（共100人）在铁门处守卫。人力车苦力坚持要通过铁门，与安南警察发生冲突。在混乱中，安南警察开枪18发，并尽力驱散人力车苦力。苦力见警察使用枪械，便撤回中国管辖区域。安南警察冲入中国管辖区域，随后返回并牢牢关闭了铁门。

冲突结果，三名安南警察受伤，12名人力车苦力受伤。安南警察丢失三支手枪。随后，公共安全局西门分局警察在羅家浜路和林路各捡获一支手枪。法国警察派副手前往公共安全局，收回了这两支手枪。

昨日，法租界和南市没有人力车运营。几辆在法租界运营的持公共租界执照的人力车轮胎被划破。南市和法租界的电车和公交车生意兴隆。

出于对意外事件的担忧，中法警察当局正在采取严格的预防措施。

冲突发生后，中国警察将受伤的人力车苦力送往三泰碼头的滬西醫院和公共卫生局的滬南醫院。五名受伤苦力在接受治疗后离开，另有两名被法国警察送往红十字会医院。其他受伤苦力的情况非常严重。

August 7, 1935. Morning Translation

Fearing that matters might take a turn for the worse, the Ricsha Owners Association at 10.30 a.m. yesterday appointed Jiu Tshung San(仇春山), Yu Yuen Ching(于连金), Koo Doo Now(顾杜茂), Tsang Wai Yuen (张怀远) and others to call on Doo Yueh Sen for assistance.

At 11 a.m. Doo Yueh Sen proceeded to the French Consulate-General on Rue du Consulat and had a conference with Mr. Baudez, the Acting Consul-General. It is reported that the attitude of the French authorities is very firm owing to the troubles earlier in the day.

At 11.30 a.m. the Acting French Consul-General called on Mayor Wu Teh Chen at the Shanghai City Government and opened negotiations.

According to information secured by a reporter of this paper from various circles, Mayor Wu will make a detailed investigation into the facts of the incident and the firing by the Annamite policemen and will later adopt concrete measures to deal with the dispute. He will punish the officials concerned for negligence of duty.

In connection with the incident, Zau Pei Sz (曹沛滋) and Tai Yeu Heng(戴有恒) of the People's Training Section of the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang, Tsu Kwei Ling(朱桂林) of the Bureau of Social Affairs and Lee Pao Tsoong(李宝钟) of the Bureau of Public Utilities called at the office of the Shanghai Municipality Ricsha Coolies Union in Poo Yoeh Tung Loo(普育东路), outside Great South Gate, at 2 p.m. yesterday to ascertain the facts. Representatives of the ricsha owners and coolies then made reports of the affair. The officials advised the coolies to resume their work pending the opening of negotiations over the incident.

Feeling among the ricsha coolies is running high over the wounding of twelve of their comrades by the Annamite policemen. Yesterday they held a meeting at which the following resolutions were passed :-
(1) That the strike be continued until the authorities of the French Concession abandon the registration of coolies.
(2) That the culprits (? Annamite policemen) be punished.
(3) That an apology be tendered.
(4) That an assurance be given that such incidents will not occur again and that no ricshas be detained without proper cause.
(5) That the Kuomintang, the civic authorities and the Chinese Ratepayers Association in the French Concession be petitioned to open negotiations with the French Consul-General.

To prevent any ricsha coolie from carrying on his work in disobedience of the resolution, the meeting will organize a number of picketing groups to deflate the tires of all ricshas that are being operated in the district.

The Ricsha Owners Association will hold a general meeting at 8 a.m. August 7 in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North Honan Road, to discuss the strike of ricsha coolies.

1935年8月7日。上午译文

因担心事态恶化，人力车车主协会于昨日上午10时30分委派仇春山、于连金、顾杜茂、张怀远等人拜访杜月笙寻求协助。

上午11时，杜月笙前往领事馆路的法国总领事馆，与代理总领事鲍德兹先生举行会谈。据报道，由于当天早些时候发生的骚乱，法国当局的态度非常强硬。

上午11时30分，法国代理总领事前往上海市政府拜访吴铁城市长，并开始谈判。

据本报记者从各方获得的消息，吴市长将对事件事实及安南警察开枪情况进行详细调查，随后将采取具体措施处理纠纷。他将惩处有关失职官员。

就此事而言，上海特别区国民党民众训练部的曹沛滋和戴有恒、社会局的朱桂林以及公用局的李宝钟，于昨日下午2时前往大南門外普育东路的上海市人力车苦力工会办事处查明事实。人力车车主和苦力代表随后汇报了事件经过。官员们建议苦力在就事件开启谈判期间恢复工作。

由于十二名同伴被安南警察打伤，人力车苦力情绪高涨。昨日他们举行会议，通过以下决议：
(1) 罢工持续，直到法租界当局放弃苦力登记制度。
(2) 惩办凶手（？安南警察）。
(3) 道歉。
(4) 保证此类事件不再发生，且不得无故扣留人力车。
(5) 请愿国民党、市政当局和法租界华人纳税会向法国总领事开启谈判。

为防止任何人力车苦力违反决议继续工作，会议将组织若干纠察队，给在该地区运营的所有人力车放气。

人力车车主协会将于8月7日上午8时在河南北路上海总商会召开大会，讨论人力车苦力罢工事宜。

August 7, 1935. Morning Translation.

In view of the wounding of ricsha coolies
of Nantao and Western District by Annamite policemen,
the ricsha owners and coolies in Chapei will voluntarily
suspend their operations to support the case.

The Citizens Federation in the Second Special

matter.

Yesterday the General Labour Union detailed
officers to inquire into the trouble and will assist the
authorities to find a quick solution of the dispute.

The Editor of the "Central China Daily News"
publishes the following remarks on the incident :-
To learn what has actually occurred we must
await the result of the investigation to be made by the
local authorities. But it was the discharge of firearms
by the Annamite Policemen which precipitated the conflict
and caused serious injuries to both sides, more especially
to the ricsha coolies. This is a fact which can be
proved by eye-witnesses.
The French Concession Authorities have
frequently permitted their policemen to open fire at
unarmed masses to the utter disregard of human life. We
should not permit them to evade responsibility and should
make them correct their mistake. Judging by the
newspaper reports, the responsibility of the French
Authorities in this affair is very grave.
As to the ricsha question itself, the Bureau
of Social Affairs, the Bureau of Public Utilities and
Mr. Doo Yueh Seng are conducting negotiations, yet the
French Authorities, prior to any decision having been
reached, have been detaining ricshas. Such action on
the part of the French Authorities may be termed very
harsh; it often leads to trouble. The coolies were all
unarmed and if the French Authorities were unwilling to
hear their appeal, they could have detailed an officer
to make this known to the coolies and advise them to
appeal to the Chinese Government. Then the City
Government would naturally arrange a proper settlement
and the incident would have been averted. The Annamite
Policemen stopped the advance of the appealing coolies
by closing the iron gate. Thus there was little
possibility for the coolies to make a further advance.
Then why did they open fire at the coolies, causing bloodshed?
Furthermore, by what right did the Annamite Policemen
make arrests beyond the boundary? Since the French
Authorities are determined to register ricsha coolies,
persuasions and explanations should have been made
beforehand; then all kinds of trouble would have been
avoided. The French Authorities did not take this
step, but strongly persisted in their attitude, thereby
aggravating the situation. The French Authorities can
have no word to defend themselves whatever for their
incompetent handling of the affair.
To fire at unarmed people is a most improper
act for which the French Authorities should, in this
case, be made to bear full responsibility. Ricsha
coolies should remain calm and give no opportunity for
evil-doers to create trouble. Thus may Might one day
surrender to Right.

1935年8月7日。晨间译文。

鉴于南市及西区人力车夫遭安南巡捕打伤，闸北的人力车主及车夫将自愿停止营运，以声援此案。

第二特区市民联合会也将召开紧急会议讨论此事。

昨日，总工会派遣干事调查此次纠纷，并将协助当局迅速解决争端。

《华中日报》编辑就此事发表如下评论：
要了解实际发生的情况，我们必须等待地方当局的调查结果。但是，正是安南巡捕的开枪行为激化了冲突，并导致双方严重受伤，尤其是人力车夫。这是目击者可以证明的事实。
法租界当局经常允许其巡捕向手无寸铁的人群开火，完全无视人命。我们不应允许他们逃避责任，而应要求他们纠正错误。从报纸报道来看，法国当局在此事中的责任非常重大。
至于人力车问题本身，社会局、公用局和杜月笙先生正在进行谈判，然而法国当局在尚未达成任何决定之前，一直扣押人力车。法国当局的这种行为可谓非常严厉；这往往导致麻烦。车夫们均手无寸铁，如果法国当局不愿听取他们的申诉，本可派一名官员将此告知车夫，并建议他们向中国政府申诉。那么，市政府自然会安排适当的解决方案，事件本可避免。安南巡捕通过关闭铁门阻止了申诉车夫的前进。因此，车夫几乎不可能再向前推进。那么，他们为何要向车夫开火，造成流血事件？此外，安南巡捕有何权利在界外逮捕人员？既然法国当局决心登记人力车夫，事先本应进行劝说和解释；这样便可避免各种麻烦。法国当局未采取这一步骤，而是强硬坚持其态度，从而加剧了局势。法国当局对其处理此事的不力，无论如何都无法为自己辩护。
向手无寸铁的人开枪是最不当的行为，在此案中，法国当局应承担全部责任。人力车夫应保持冷静，不给恶人制造事端的机会。如此，强权终有一日会向公理低头。

D.C. (CRIME)
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. I. COUNTRY. / Special Branch, No. D 5670. / August 6, 1935. / D4835.）

Ricshas with French Concession Licences belonging
to Hongs in French Concession and Nantao -
Suspend Business

The ricsha hongs affected by the enforcement of the
C.M.F.'s decision to license ricsha pullers suspended business
at 5 a.m. to-day, August 6. These hongs, of which many are
located in Nantao, own about 6,200 ricshas. Four hundred and
sixty-eight of these vehicles are detailed by the French Police,
having been captured on the streets during the past five days
because the coolies pulling them had failed to register with the
French Authorities. The ricsha hongs in Sicawei, who
own about nine hundred vehicles with Frenchtown licence numbers,
have not joined the strike.

As a means to enforce the suspension of all ricsha
traffic in Nantao and the French Concession, some 30 coolies led
by foremen and owners started from the Nantao Office of the Ricsha
Owners' Association, 25 San Kwan Dong Ka, Nantao, at 9 a.m.
to-day, August 6, and proceeded to various places in the French
Concession and Nantao with the object of deflating the tyres of
ricshas which are still operating.

Three Annamite policemen who came into collision with
this sabotage gang in the vicinity of St Catherine's Bridge
were roughly manhandled. As a result of the injuries they
received all three are now in hospital. Having received
news of this attack, the French Police rapidly dispatched
reinforcements to the scene. These succeeded in dispersing the
rioters and arresting six of their number who in due course will
be prosecuted for the assault on the Police. The French
Authorities are maintaining patrols in the vicinity of Route de
Zikawei and St Catherine's Bridge in anticipation of a further
outbreak.

持有法租界执照、隶属于法租界及南市车行的人力车——
停止营业

受法公董局（C.M.F.）关于人力车夫领照决定执行的影响，相关人力车行于今日（8月6日）凌晨5时停止营业。这些车行许多位于南市，拥有约6,200辆人力车。其中468辆车被法国警方扣留，因为在过去五天中，拉这些车的车夫未能向法国当局登记。徐家汇的人力车行拥有约九百辆持法租界牌照的车辆，未参加罢工。

为了强制停止南市和法租界的所有人力车交通，约30名由工头和车主带领的车夫，于今日（8月6日）上午9时从位于南市三官堂街25号的南市人力车主协会办事处出发，前往法租界和南市的各个地方，目的是给仍在运营的人力车放气。

三名在圣凯瑟琳桥附近与这一破坏团伙发生冲突的安南巡捕遭到粗暴殴打。由于受伤，三人目前均在医院。接到袭击消息后，法国警方迅速向现场增派援兵。成功驱散了暴徒，并逮捕了其中六人，他们随后将以袭击警察罪被起诉。法国当局正在徐家汇路和圣凯瑟琳桥附近维持巡逻，以防再次爆发骚乱。

At 4.30 p.m. August 5, Shou Tsung-san (仇春山) and Chang Wei-yang (張懷揚), representing the Nantao Office of the Shanghai Municipality Public Ricsha Owners' Association, 34 San Ming Fang, Pu Yueh Tung Road, Nantao, called on Tu Yueh-sung, Chairman of the French Concession Chinese Ratepayers' Association, at 216 Rue Wagner, his residence. They were received by Tu Yueh-sung who informed them that the C.M.F. had agreed to discuss at the next Council meeting a proposal to reduce registration fees which at present amount to 50 cents per coolie. Mr. Tu further enjoined upon the callers to await peacefully the result of Council's deliberations and further negotiations.

At 5 p.m. the same day, about 250 owners and coolies held a meeting in the "Free Coffin Distribution Centre" of the Nantao Owners' Association, 25 San Kwan Dong Ka, Nantao. Shou Tsung-san and Chang Wei-yang reported the result of the interview with Tu Yueh-sung and advised the owners to instruct their coolies to register with the C.M.F. and justified this advice by pleading that this course could not be avoided.

On hearing the statements of Shou and Chang, some of those present accused the Association of having changed its attitude, and shouted that they had sworn to oppose to the bitter end the registration of the pullers. When the meeting again became calm, the attendance demanded that the Association should declare a strike. Shou Tsung-san, who is a member of the Standing Committee of the Association, then announced that he and the other members of the Association would not be responsible for any untoward occurrences resulting from this decision.

A quarrel followed between the members of the Committee and the general body of owners and the members of the Bureau of Public Safety had to be summoned to restore order.

When the Police left, the attendance again showed their opposition to Chang and Shou in a vociferous way. This

8月5日下午4时30分，代表位于南市蒲悦通路34号三明坊的上海市公营人力车主协会南市办事处的仇春山和張懷揚，前往瓦格纳路216号拜访法租界华人纳税会主席杜月笙住所。杜月笙接见了他们，并告知他们法公董局已同意在下一次董事会议上讨论降低登记费的提议，目前登记费为每名车夫50分。杜先生还告诫来访者平静等待董事会审议结果及进一步谈判。

同日下午5时，约250名车主和车夫在位于南市三官堂街25号的南市车主协会“施棺局”举行会议。仇春山和張懷揚汇报了与杜月笙会谈的结果，并建议车主指示其车夫向法公董局登记，辩称此举不可避免，以此为其建议辩护。

听到仇和张的陈述后，部分在场人员指责协会改变了态度，并高呼他们曾发誓要坚决反对车夫登记。当会议再次恢复平静时，与会人员要求协会宣布罢工。身为协会常务委员会成员的仇春山随即宣布，他和协会其他成员不对由此决定产生的任何意外事件负责。

随后，委员会成员与广大车主之间发生争吵，不得不召来公安局成员恢复秩序。

警察离开后，与会人员再次以喧闹的方式表示对张和仇的反对。这
