August 6, 1935. Morning translation.

THE REGISTRATION OF RICSHA COOLIES IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION

At the request of ricsha owners in the
French Concession, Doo Yueh Seng ( ) called on the
French Police on the morning of August 5 to mediate in
the dispute over the registration of ricsha coolies.
The French Authorities promised to re-consider the amount
of the registration fee, but insisted that all other
matters relating to registration must be carried out.
The French Authorities added that the detained ricshas
would not be returned unless the pullers register.
The situation has thus become very grave.
On August 5, the French Police continued to seize ricshas.
At 6 p.m. yesterday, ricshas coolies in the
French Concession held a meeting at Nan Mou Deu (南碼頭),
Nantao, at which some 200 coolies were present.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That a petition be presented on August 6 to the local
Tangpu, the Shanghai City Government, the Bureau of
Social Affairs and the Bureau of Public Utilities
requesting assistance.
2. That representatives be elected to submit an appeal
to the French Police, the Chinese Ratepayers' Association,
the Citizens' Federation and the Chinese members of
the French Municipal Council.
3. That the Ricsha Owners' Association, ricsha owners and
coolies in the International Settlement, Chapei and
the Western District be requested to render assistance.
4. That a manifesto be issued.

Having learned that the negotiations over
the ricsha trouble have had no result, ricsha coolies in
the French Concession at 7 p.m. yesterday assaulted and
injured Chang Van Yang (張樣楊) and Zeu Zang San (仇春山),
members of the Standing Committee of the Ricsha Owners'
Association. A party of Chinese Police from the West
Gate Branch of the Bureau of Public Safety arrived and
removed the injured to a hospital.

1935年8月6日。晨间译文。

法租界人力车夫登记事宜

应法租界人力车主的请求，杜月笙（ ）于8月5日上午拜访法国警方，调解人力车夫登记纠纷。法国当局承诺重新考虑登记费金额，但坚持必须执行与登记有关的所有其他事项。法国当局补充说，除非车夫登记，否则被扣人力车不予发还。
因此，局势变得非常严峻。
8月5日，法国警方继续扣押人力车。
昨日下午6时，法租界的人力车夫在南市南码头举行会议，约有200名车夫出席。
通过以下决议：
1. 于8月6日向当地党部、上海市政府、社会局和公用局呈递请愿书，请求援助。
2. 选举代表向法国警方、华人纳税会、市民联合会和法公董局华董提出申诉。
3. 请求公共租界、闸北和西区的人力车主协会、人力车主及车夫提供援助。
4. 发布宣言。

得知人力车纠纷谈判无果后，法租界的人力车夫于昨晚7时袭击并打伤了人力车主协会常务委员会成员張樣楊和仇春山。公安局西门分局的一队中国警察赶到，将伤者送往医院。

City Government Plans
'New Deal' For Ricshas

Preparations are being made by the City Government of Greater Shanghai to introduce a "New Deal" in the ricsha industry in Chinese-controlled areas of the municipality.

The establishment of a Ricsha Administration to take steps for municipal ownership of ricshas, the improvement of living conditions of the pullers, and the improve-

ment of the ricsha models are major features of the program now being studied by the City Government, it is understood.

Dr. Paul Hsu, commissioner of Public Utilities, is responsible for drafting of the program and it is expected that he will be appointed concurrently director of the Ricsha Administration when it is organized.

市政府计划
对人力车实行“新政”

据悉，大上海市政府正在筹备在上海市华界地区的人力车行业推行一项“新政”。

该方案的主要内容包括：设立人力车管理处，采取步骤实现人力车的市政公有，改善车夫的生活条件，以及改进人力车型号。目前市政府正在研究该方案。

公用局局长徐博士（Dr. Paul Hsu）负责起草该方案，预计在该管理处成立时，他将兼任处长一职。

RICKSHAW QUARREL
IS FINISHED
Fear of Finger-Prints Causes
Hesitation
Hesitation on the part of the rick-
shaw coolies to come before the
French authorities is attributed to a
fear amongst some of them that the
taking of their finger-prints will
signify their adherence to the
Catholic religion. Others labour under
the belief that this measure implies
that they would be taken to the
Front in the event of another World
War, while still a third party is
under the misapprehension that it
will mean leaving their wives.
In the opinion of the French Police,
however, the "Rickshaw Quarrel" is
definitely finished. The objections
on the part of the owners are said
to have lost much of their force and
they are being gradually brought
around to see that the measures
decided upon by the French authori-
ties are to the mutual benefit of both
parties. In consequence, the registra-
tion fee per puller has been reduced
from fifty cents to twenty cents
in cases where the authorities have
decided that the owners no longer
object to the new measures.
Registrations are now being made
at the rate of 500 pullers a day,
while practically all the rickshaws
which had been seized and tem-
porarily held at the various police
stations have been taken back by
the owners.
The decrease in registration fees
have not raised any further objection
on the part of the owners, as not
only do they not constitute a source
of revenue to the French Concession,
but represent the sum of thirty
cents paid out per puller registered
"The incident is closed," state the
French Police confidently.

已告结束
指纹恐惧导致犹豫

部分人力车苦力不愿前往法国当局面前，据称是因为他们中有些人担心，采集指纹意味着他们必须信奉天主教。另一些人则认为，这一措施暗示若再次爆发世界大战，他们将被征召上前线；还有一部分人误以为这意味着要抛弃妻子。

然而，法国警方认为，“人力车纠纷”已确凿无疑地结束。据说车主们的反对意见已大大减弱，他们正逐渐被说服，认识到法国当局所决定的措施对双方均有利。因此，在当局认定车主不再反对新措施的情况下，每名车夫的注册费已从五十美分降至二十美分。

目前的注册速度为每天500名车夫，而此前在各警察局被扣押并暂时保管的几乎所有的人力车，都已被车主领回。

注册费的降低并未引起车主们的进一步反对，因为这不仅不构成法租界的收入来源，反而代表每注册一名车夫需支出三十美分。“事件已了结，”法国警方自信地表示。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, TUESDAY, AUGUST 6, 1935
11348
S. C. REC.
D. D. 8670
20 8 35

Split Between Owners
And Pullers Reported
On Ricsha Registration

Decision To
Strike To-day
Said Reached

Concession Authorities
Deny Statement Made
By Owners' Delegate

NO OFFICIAL REPORT
OF MEETING ISSUED

French Police Determined
Not To Give Way; Hope
Of Early Settlement

Reported splits in the
ranks of both ricsha owners
and pullers; a statement
from a delegate of the own-
ers that a strike would be
declared by the pullers to-
day, the denial of the state-
ment by the Concession
authorities and a further
announcement by the French
Police asserting that they
were determined not to give
way to either party regard-
ing ricsha registration; this
summarizes the situation
which had been reached late
last night in the Concession
regarding the conflict be-
tween the three parties over
the new regulations which
came into force in French-
town at the beginning of this
month requiring the registra-
tion of all pullers.

The strike declaration was
made to "The Shanghai Times"
by a leader of the Owners' As-
sociation delegates which met Mr.
Tu Yueh-sen, managing director
of the Chun Wai Bank yesterday
morning and later in the day held
a meeting from which the public
was excluded, and on which no
official statement has yet been
made to the French Police.

The delegates requested Mr. Tu
to mediate with the French
authorities on their behalf, and
according to a report made public
yesterday afternoon, Mr. Tu con-
ferred with responsible officials of
the Municipal Council of the
French Concession. In the after-
noon delegates chosen by the
owners and pullers met Mr. Tu
at the latter's residence and Mr.
Tu advised them to register, ex-
plaining that it was to their
advantage to do so.

One of the delegates who parti-
cipated in yesterday afternoon's
meeting at Mr. Tu's home asserted
that the owners were willing to
compromise by helping the author-
ities in the matter of registration,
but the pullers were most
determined in their opposition to
the new policy.

The pullers, he declared, were
specially opposed to the sugges-
tion that while applying for re-
gistration they must present their
photographs.

Detained Machines

While the same delegate declar-
ed that 400 ricshas were still be-
ing detained by the French Police,
an authoritative statement made
by the Police to "The Shanghai
Times" last night reported that
only about 250 vehicles were be-
ing held.

No further machines were de-
tained yesterday, the statement
added, and the number had actual-
ly been decreased yesterday by
a few pullers applying for re-
gistration and the return of their
ricshas.

An official of the Concession
Police ridiculed the suggestion that
the pullers would strike to-day.
"The pullers actually have little
to do with the matter," he declar-
ed, "and the decision rests with
the owners. If they agree to ac-
cept the new regulations there
will be no further trouble. But
if they don't ... well, the
French Police are determined not
to give way one inch to either of
the parties.

Disagree At Meetings

According to two reports from
authoritative sources, neither the
pullers nor the owners could
reach an agreement among them-
selves at yesterday's meeting.
While more than half the owners
were in favour of giving way to
the Concession authorities, there
was still sufficient opposition to
maintain the deadlock.

Similarly at the pullers' meet-
ing, after a noisy session, no
unanimous decision was reported
reached. According to some of
the pullers, many of their mem-
bers have left Shanghai for their
homes in the country as they were
unable to await further develop-
ments, while others were anxious
to settle the dispute immediately
by registering. Again, however,
there was reported to be a heavy
opposition.

A statement was made by the
owners that it was expected 2,000
pullers would march to the Nantao
Kuomintang headquarters this
morning to petition for assistance
in settling the dispute.

《上海泰晤士报》，1935年8月6日，星期二
11348
S. C. REC.
D. D. 8670
20 8 35

据报道车主
与车夫在人力车
注册问题上出现分裂

据称已决定
今日罢工

租界当局
否认车主代表
所作声明

未发布会议
官方报告

法国警方决心
不让步；希望
早日解决

据报道，人力车车主和车夫阵营内部均出现分裂；车主代表团的一名代表声明车夫将于今日宣布罢工；租界当局否认了这一声明；法国警方进一步发表公告，声称在人力车注册问题上决心不向任何一方让步；以上情况概括了昨晚深夜租界内三方就本月初在法租界生效、要求所有车夫进行注册的新规所产生的冲突所达成的局面。

该罢工宣言是由车主协会代表团的一名领袖向《上海泰晤士报》作出的。该代表团昨日上午会见了春外银行（Chun Wai Bank）总经理杜月笙先生，并于当日稍后举行了一次不对公众开放的会议，目前尚未向法国警方发表任何官方声明。

代表团请求杜先生代表他们与法国当局进行调解。据昨日下午公布的一份报告称，杜先生已与法租界公董局的相关官员进行了磋商。下午，由车主和车夫选出的代表在杜先生寓所与其会面，杜先生建议他们进行注册，并解释说这样做对他们有利。

一名参加昨日下午在杜先生家中会议的代表声称，车主们愿意通过在注册事宜上协助当局来达成妥协，但车夫们对新政策的反对最为坚决。

他宣称，车夫们特别反对在申请职位注册时必须提交照片的建议。

车辆被扣

尽管同一名代表声称仍有400辆人力车被法国警方扣押，但警方昨晚向《上海泰晤士报》发表的一份权威声明称，被扣留的车辆仅约250辆。

该声明补充说，昨日没有进一步扣留车辆，实际上，由于少数车夫申请注册并取回了他们的人力车，被扣车辆数量昨日略有减少。

租界警方的一名官员嘲笑了车夫将于今日罢工的说法。“车夫实际上与此事关系不大，”他宣称，“决定权在于车主。如果他们同意接受新规，就不会再有麻烦。但如果他们不同意……好吧，法国警方决心在任何一方都不退让寸步。”

会议上意见不一

据两份来自权威消息源的报告称，在昨日的会议上，无论是车夫还是车主，均未能在内部达成一致。虽然超过半数的车主倾向于向租界当局让步，但反对意见仍然足以维持僵局。

同样，在车夫的会议上，经过一番喧闹的讨论后，据报道也未达成一致决定。据一些车夫称，他们的许多成员因无法等待事态进一步发展，已离开上海返回乡下老家，而其他人则急于通过注册立即解决争端。然而，据报道仍存在强烈的反对意见。

车主方面发表声明称，预计今晨将有2000名车夫游行至南市国民党总部，请愿寻求协助解决纠纷。

Licensing Fees Should

More than 50 representatives
chosen by ricsha pullers in French
Concession and Nantao held a
meeting on Thursday, at which
they decided to ask ricsha owners
to pay their registration fees which
have been officially fixed at 50
cents per head. The owners
should also provide uniforms for
all pullers, it was suggested.
Another decision that may cause
a great difference of opinion be-
tween the owners and pullers was
the one calling for a reduction of
ricsha rentals. It was not made
public yesterday, however, just
how far the pullers would go in
carrying out their demands, but
it was reported that since they
also passed a resolution asking for
improvement of living conditions
in general, this indicated strong
determination.
Those attending the meeting
also alleged that the French police
had in their custody a ricsha
coolie named Shieh Shan, who was
reported missing after the recent

They decided to send several re-
presentatives to petition the
Chinese Ratepayers Association
of the French Concession to
obtain his freedom.

THE CHINA PRESS, THURSDAY, AUGUST 1, 1935
（批：11313）
（批：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
（批：S. I. R.）
（批：No. S. B. D. 5670）
（批：Date 2 8 35）

Pullers In Concession May Strike

Settlement, Frenchtown Cops Ordered To Stand By Today As Registration Showdown Forced

City Government Asks For Postponement In Effort To Avoid Trouble

Orders to maintain a state of mobilization throughout today in readiness for immediate action have been issued to police forces of the International Settlement and French Concession in anticipation of possible disturbances by ricksha pullers.

With the determination of the French Municipal Council to enforce compulsory registration of public pullers starting today and with the equally determined attitude on the part of public pullers in the Concession not to register, a major battle on the ricksha front in the Concession looms with the F.M.C. on the one side and over 50,000 angry public pullers who are backed up by public ricksha owners, on the other.

The expected strife today, which may result in a strike of Concession pullers, contrasts with the completion yesterday of the registration of 36,761 public pullers in the Settlement, such registration having started on November 19, 1934. Yet all is not quiet on the Settlement ricksha front and Settlement Police are prepared to face any repercussion that expected troubles in Frenchtown may bring.

Would Reduce Pullers

The determination of Concession pullers to refuse to register follows from the announcement by F.M.C. authorities of its intention to reduce the number of pullers. The F.M.C. proposes to license considerably less than the present approximate total of 50,000 public pullers in the Concession. After the licensing of the proscribed number of pullers, the balance comprising unregistered pullers will not be allowed to pull vehicles.

Other factors enter into the pullers' opposition. They are opposed to the licensing fee attached with registration, they are opposed to compulsory and not voluntary registration, they foresee after the reduction in the number of pullers a reduction in the total number of 17,000 public rickshas in the Concession, and they are opposed to what they vaguely term "regimentation."

The owners are also opposed to the F.M.C. plan. Part of the onus of registration of the public pullers has been placed on the owners. They have consistently maintained the stand that they were not responsible for the registration of pullers and could not assume any responsibility for their registration. In reply to a deputation of the owners stated that the F.M.C. was determined to enforce registration and that a compromise could be reached later on points at issue.

Threaten Strike

Frenchtown pullers, who have voiced their protest to compulsory registration from the minute it was announced, have threatened to cease pulling if the F.M.C. attempted to put through forced registration. Hence the walkout of some 50,000 pullers in the Concession looms today.

While outwardly the ricksha situation in the Settlement has been calm, inwardly there is much bickering among the pullers as to certain points of the Council's administration. First and foremost the pullers want reduced rental fares, specifically, the reduction of the present rental of from 12 to 14 dimes (small money) to 80 cents small money per shift. Recommendation that 80 cents small money should be fixed as the rental fee was made by the Ricksha Committee on February 13, 1934, but has not been carried into effect. The pullers in the Settlement now pay almost as much rent for their vehicles as they did before the ricksha reforms in the Settlement. Secondly, they desire a representative management on the Pullers' Mutual Aid Society, which they support. Up to recently no pullers were represented on the management staff; two weeks ago two pullers were allowed to sit on a board of management of 13 members. The pullers still feel that this allotment is undemocratic.

Police Ready

In view of possible repercussions in the Settlement of the expected trouble in the Concession, Settlement police are taking precautions and will be on the alert today for any disturbances. Frenchtown police are also prepared for disturbances but despite the threat are determined to carry out registration.

There are 9,990 public rickshas in the Settlement with about three pullers for each. In the Concession there are 17,000 public rickshas, with the same number of pullers for each vehicle. In the Settlement 140,000 people look to ricksha pulling for their livelihood; in the Concession, 210,000 people. The Settlement and Concession total of 350,000 people are dependent upon ricksha pulling for their livelihood.

City Government Intervenes

Yesterday a group of more than 40 delegates of rickshamen of French Concession, led by Mr. Chin Chang-sheng, again called at the headquarters of the Ricksha Pullers' Association in Nantao reiterating their opposition against the registration required by the French Municipal Council.

The Bureau of Social Affairs of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai is reported to have sent officials to interview authorities of the French Municipal Council yesterday with regard to the question of registration of rickshamen in French Concession. During the meeting, the Social Affairs Bureau officials are said to have proposed that the registration be postponed with a view to avoid possible trouble. The French Municipal Council, however, is reported bent on carrying out its program without any further delay.

租界车夫可能罢工

鉴于登记摊牌在即，公共租界与法租界警察奉命今日待命

市政府为避免麻烦请求延期

为防备人力车夫可能引发的骚乱，国际公共租界和法租界的警力已接到命令，要求全天保持动员状态，随时准备立即采取行动。

随着法公董局决心从今天开始强制执行公共人力车夫的强制登记，以及租界内公共人力车夫同样坚决地拒绝登记，租界人力车战线上的一场大战迫在眉睫：一方是法公董局，另一方是得到公共人力车主支持的5万多名愤怒的车夫。

预计今天发生的冲突可能导致租界车夫罢工，这与昨日公共租界完成36,761名公共车夫登记的情况形成对比，该登记工作始于1934年11月19日。然而，公共租界的人力车战线并非一片平静，租界巡捕房已准备好应对法租界预期麻烦可能带来的任何反响。

旨在减少车夫数量

法租界车夫决心拒绝登记，源于法公董局当局宣布其意图减少车夫数量。法公董局计划发放的执照数量将远远少于目前租界内约5万名公共车夫的总数。在规定数量的车夫获得执照后，其余未登记的车夫将被禁止拉车。

其他因素也导致了车夫的反对。他们反对与登记挂钩的执照费，反对强制而非自愿登记，他们预见到车夫数量减少后，租界内17,000辆公共人力车的总数也会减少，并且他们反对他们模糊地称为“军事化管理”的措施。

车主们也反对法公董局的计划。部分公共车夫登记的责任被加在了车主身上。他们一贯坚持认为，他们不对车夫的登记负责，也无法承担任何登记责任。作为对车主代表团的回应，法公董局表示决心执行登记，并称稍后可就争议点达成妥协。

威胁罢工

法租界车夫从宣布强制登记的那一刻起就表达了抗议，并威胁说如果法公董局试图强行实施登记，他们将停止拉车。因此，租界内约5万名车夫的罢工今天迫在眉睫。

虽然表面上公共租界的人力车局势平静，但车夫内部对工部局管理的某些方面存在诸多争执。首先，车夫希望降低租车费，具体而言，是将目前每班次12至14角（小洋）的租金降至80分小洋。人力车委员会曾于1934年2月13日建议将租金定为80分小洋，但该建议尚未实施。目前，公共租界的车夫为其车辆支付的租金几乎与租界人力车改革前一样多。其次，他们希望在他们所支持的车夫互助会中拥有代表性的管理层。直到最近，管理层中还没有车夫代表；两周前，两名车夫获准进入由13名成员组成的管理委员会。车夫们仍觉得这一名额分配不够民主。

警方严阵以待

鉴于法租界预期的麻烦可能在公共租界引起反响，公共租界警方正在采取预防措施，并将在今日警惕任何骚乱。法租界警方也为骚乱做好了准备，但尽管受到威胁，仍决心执行登记。

公共租界有9,990辆公共人力车，每辆车约有三名车夫。法租界有17,000辆公共人力车，每辆车的车夫数量相同。在公共租界，有14万人依靠拉人力车谋生；在法租界，这一数字为21万人。公共租界和法租界共有35万人依靠拉人力车谋生。

市政府介入

昨天，由金长生（音译）先生率领的40多名法租界人力车夫代表再次前往南市人力车夫协会总部，重申他们反对法公董局要求的登记。

据报道，大上海市政府社会局昨日已派官员就法租界人力车夫登记问题会见法公董局当局。据悉，在会议期间，社会局官员提议推迟登记，以避免可能的麻烦。然而，据报道，法公董局决心不再拖延，坚持执行其计划。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 27, 1934
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C. & S. DEPT. No. D ...）

More Agitation Over Ricsha
Licences In Frenchtown
Small Hong Owners Protest Against Seizure Of
Licences By Bigger Groups; “China Times”
Advocates Abolition Of Vehicles

Agitation against the bigger groups of ricsha licence holders is growing among the small hong owners, following the decision of the French Concession authorities to limit the number of ricshas in that area. The smaller owners claim that the bigger groups took out all available licences before the small owners were given a chance to make application for their quota. On Saturday, about 50 ricsha coolies with their vehicles proceeded to the office of the Shanghai Municipality Ricsha Owners' Association, Nantao, where they asked for a representative to accompany them to the French Municipal Council to lodge a protest against the limitation of ricshas. When the Association refused to comply with their request the coolies left quietly.

The following day about 80 small ricsha owners, who were unable to secure licences for their vehicles after the limitation order of the French Municipal Council, held a meeting at which it was alleged that they had been tricked by committee members of the Ricsha Owners' Association who had taken up all available licences.

It was decided that the French Municipal Council be requested to register all owners of public ricshas in order to ascertain the true owners and holders of licences. The Council is to be urged to take legal proceedings against persons who have secured more licences than their due. In order to compensate small owners for loss of licences the Council is asked to compel the bigger owners to surrender one in every twenty licences to the smaller holders.

Chinese Comment

In connection with the ricsha situation in the International Settlement, the first meeting of the Watch and Traffic Committees to study the Ricsha Report was held yesterday. Since the issue of the report, with one or two exceptions, the vernacular press has been silent regarding the recommendations and editorial comment has been lacking. In yesterday's issue of the "China Times," however, the following editorial advocating the abolition of ricshas in the city was published:

Recently the S.M.C. Ricsha Commission published a report of its findings during the past five months. The report is divided into three chapters and is a valuable reference work. Questions concerning the numbers of ricshas and pullers, prices of ricshas and rentals, the relationship between ricsha owner and puller and the life of ricsha pullers have been fully described. Furthermore the report reveals exploitation of poor people of which the community has hitherto been ignorant. After reading the report, we make the following comment:

The substitution of human labour for the beast of burden was an institution of mediaeval times. After the industrial revolution some advanced countries in Europe and America vied with one another in installing machines to replace human power. From that time onward, human labour has been gradually replaced by machinery. The ricsha puller, however, is similar to a beast of burden. Looking round the world, we find that it is only in Asia that the relic of the mediaeval age remains.

Of late the number of ricshas in Japan has dwindled to such an extent that the vehicle is no longer considered as a means of transport.

In our country external aggression and the low cost of human labour have prevented the develop-

法租界人力车执照引发更多骚动
小车行主抗议大集团没收执照；《时报》主张废除该车辆

继法租界当局决定限制该地区人力车数量后，小车行主对大型人力车执照持有者集团的 agitation（骚动/抗议）日益增长。较小的车主声称，在小型车主有机会申请其配额之前，大型集团已将所有可用的执照申领一空。周六，约50名人力车夫携其车辆前往位于南市（Nantao）的上海市人力车车主协会办公室，要求派出一名代表陪同他们前往法国公董局，就限制人力车一事提出抗议。当协会拒绝配合他们的请求时，车夫们安静地离开了。

次日，约80名在法国公董局发布限制令后无法为其车辆获得执照的小型人力车车主举行了一次会议，会上指控他们被人力车车主协会的委员会成员欺骗，这些成员占用了所有可用的执照。

会议决定，请求法国公董局登记所有公共人力车的所有者，以便查明真正的所有者和执照持有人。还将敦促公董局对那些获取超过其应得数量执照的人采取法律行动。为了补偿小型车主因失去执照而遭受的损失，要求公董局强制大型车主每二十张执照中向小型持有者交出一张。

华人舆论

关于公共租界的人力车状况，巡捕房与交通委员会研究《人力车报告》的第一次会议于昨日召开。自该报告发布以来，除一两处例外，中文报刊对其建议保持沉默，且缺乏社论评论。然而，在昨日的《时报》上，发表了以下主张在城市中废除人力车的社论：

最近，上海公共租界工部局人力车委员会发布了其过去五个月调查结果的报告。该报告分为三章，是一份有价值的参考著作。有关人力车和车夫的数量、人力车价格和租金、车主与车夫之间的关系以及人力车夫的生活等问题都得到了充分描述。此外，该报告揭示了社会此前不知情的对穷人的剥削。阅读报告后，我们发表如下评论：

以人力代替畜力是中世纪的一种制度。工业革命后，欧美一些先进国家竞相安装机器以取代人力。从那时起，人力逐渐被机械所取代。然而，人力车夫类似于驮兽。环顾世界，我们发现只有亚洲还保留着中世纪的遗迹。

近来，日本的人力车数量已锐减至该车辆不再被视为一种交通工具的程度。

在我国，外来侵略和低廉的人力成本阻碍了交通系统的发

We must know all the aspects
of the ricsha question and endeav-
our to relieve the distress of
thousands of poor pullers whose

Contract System
According to the report, there
are 69,141 ricshas in Shanghai
and the people depending upon
these vehicles for a living number
nearly 200,000, but all the vehicles
are in the hands of a few owners.
There are people who possess no
ricshas but who have ricsha
licences, people who lease their
vehicles to others but who only
take charge of obtaining licences
and people who own vehicles and
conduct the business themselves.
Thus we have the "large con-
tractors" and the "small con-
tractors." In the International
Settlement, the nett profit of the
ricsha owner is from $21 to $23
per month for each vehicle. The
profit on a vehicle amounts to 300
times its price. The ricsha
owners are able to earn such a
monstrous profit because the
S.M.C. limits the number of
licences and licences are in great
demand. Hence a licence plate
can fetch from $400 to $700.
Furthermore, the ricsha owners,
being selfish, have no regard for
the cleanliness of the ricshas. The
average sum of money earned
monthly by a ricsha coolie is less
than $10 and they cannot support
parents, wives and children on
this small sum. In addition, the
ricsha coolies are often the victims
of oppression. They have their
licence plates and cushions seized
by policemen and are beaten with
police batons.
They were not born to be ricsha
coolies, but owing to the fact that
they have no skilled trade, they
are forced to pull ricshas in order
to live. They are better than
criminals who obtain their liveli-
hood by fraud and other methods.
The ricsha coolies are blamed in
the community by motor-car
drivers and pedestrians. Instead
of having pity for the ignorance
of the ricsha coolies, motor-car
drivers and pedestrians abuse and
assault them.
Now, the S.M.C. has drawn up
a system for the enforcement of
reformation in the ricsha system.
We hope that the local authorities
will aim at the abolition of ricshas

cles annually. The ricsha mer-
chants must reduce their charges

must be owned by the coolies
themselves.

承包制度
根据报告，上海有69,141辆人力车，依靠这些车辆谋生的人数近20万，但所有车辆都掌握在少数车主手中。有些人没有人力车但拥有人力车执照，有些人将车辆出租给他人但只负责办理执照，还有些人拥有车辆并亲自经营业务。因此，我们有“大包商”和“小包商”。在公共租界，人力车车主每辆车的月净利润为21至23美元。一辆车的利润是其价格的300倍。人力车车主之所以能获得如此惊人的利润，是因为工部局限制了执照数量，而执照需求量大。因此，一张牌照可卖到400至700美元。此外，人力车车主自私自利，不顾人力车的清洁。人力车夫每月平均收入不到10美元，这点钱不足以赡养父母、妻子和儿女。此外，人力车夫经常成为压迫的受害者。他们的牌照和坐垫被警察没收，并遭到警棍殴打。
他们生来并非要做人力车夫，但由于没有熟练技艺，被迫拉人力车以维持生计。他们比那些通过欺诈和其他手段谋生的罪犯要好。
人力车夫受到社会中汽车司机和行人的指责。汽车司机和行人不同情人力车夫的无知，反而辱骂和殴打他们。
现在，工部局已制定了一套实施人力车制度改革的方案。我们希望地方当局旨在通过每年减少车辆数量来废除人力车。人力车商人必须降低人力车收费，随后车辆必须由车夫自己拥有。
